title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:1
content: 1 A littafina na farko, Tiyofilus, na rubuta game da dukan abin da Yesu ya fara yi, da abin da ya koyar

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:2
content: 2 har zuwa ranar da aka ɗauke shi zuwa sama, bayan ya ba da umarnai ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ga manzannin da ya zaɓa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:3
content: 3 Bayan wahalarsa, ya bayyana kansa ga waɗannan mutane ya kuma ba da tabbatattun alamu masu yawa cewa yana da rai. Ya bayyana a gare su har kwana arba’in ya kuma yi musu magana game da mulkin Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:4
content: 4 A wani lokaci, yayinda yake ci tare da su, ya ba su wannan umarni, “Kada ku bar Urushalima, amma ku jira kyautar da Ubana ya yi alkawari, wadda kuka ji na yi magana a kai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:5
content: 5 Gama Yohanna ya yi baftisma da ruwa, amma a cikin ’yan kwanaki za a yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:6
content: 6 Saboda haka, sa’ad da suka taru, sai suka tambaye shi, “Ubangiji, a wannan lokaci za ka mayar da mulki ga Isra’ila?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:7
content: 7 Ya ce musu, “Ba naku ba ne ku san lokuta ko ranakun da Uban ya shirya cikin ikonsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:8
content: 8 Amma ku za ku karɓi iko sa’ad da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka a kanku; za ku kuma zama shaiduna cikin Urushalima, da kuma cikin dukan Yahudiya da Samariya, zuwa kuma iyakar duniya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:9
content: 9 Bayan ya faɗi wannan, sai aka ɗauke shi sama a idanunsu sai wani girgije ya rufe shi daga ganinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:10
content: 10 Suna zuba ido a bisa, zuwa cikin sararin sama yayinda yake tafiya, nan da nan, sai ga mutane biyu saye da fararen riguna tsaye kusa da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:11
content: 11 Sai suka ce, “Mutanen Galili, don me kuke tsaye a nan kuna duban sararin sama? Wannan Yesu, wanda aka ɗauke daga gare ku zuwa sama, zai komo daidai yadda kuka ga ya tafi sama.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:12
content: 12 Sai suka koma Urushalima daga tudun da ake kira Dutsen Zaitun, tafiyar ranar Asabbaci guda daga birnin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:13
content: 13 Da suka iso, sai suka hau gidan sama, zuwa ɗakin da suke zama. Waɗanda suka kasance kuwa su ne, Bitrus, Yohanna, Yaƙub da Andarawus; Filibus da Toma; Bartolomeyu da Mattiyu; Yaƙub ɗan Alfayus da Siman Zilot, da kuma Yahuda ɗan Yaƙub.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:14
content: 14 Waɗannan duka suka duƙufa cikin addu’a, tare da waɗansu mata da Maryamu mahaifiyar Yesu, da kuma tare da ’yan’uwansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:15
content: 15 A waɗancan kwanakin Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye cikin ’yan’uwa masu bi (taron da ya yi kusan mutum ɗari da ashirin)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:16
content: 16 ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, dole a cika Nassin nan da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya yi magana tun da daɗewa ta bakin Dawuda game da Yahuda, wanda ya zama jagora ga waɗanda suka kama Yesu

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:17
content: 17 dā shi ɗaya ne cikinmu, ya kuma yi hidima a cikin aikin nan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:18
content: 18 (Da ladar da ya samu saboda muguntarsa Yahuda ya sayi wani fili; a can ya fāɗi da kā, jikinsa ya fashe, hanjinsa kuma duk suka zubo.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:19
content: 19 Kowa a Urushalima ya ji game da wannan, saboda haka suka kira wannan filin Akeldama, da yarensu, wato, Filin Jini.)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:20
content: 20 Bitrus ya ce, “Gama yana a rubuce a cikin Littafin Zabura cewa, “ ‘Bari wurinsa yă zama babu kowa; kada kowa ya zauna a cikinsa,’ kuma, “ ‘Bari wani ya ɗauki matsayinsa na shugabanci.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:21
content: 21 Saboda haka dole a zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin mutanen da suke tare da mu duk lokacin da Ubangiji Yesu yake shiga da fita a cikinmu,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:22
content: 22 farawa daga baftisma ta Yohanna har zuwa sa’ad da aka ɗauke Yesu daga gare mu. Gama dole ɗaya daga waɗannan ya zama shaidar tashinsa daga matattu tare da mu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:23
content: 23 Saboda haka suka gabatar da mutane biyu. Yusuf mai suna Barsabbas (da aka kuma sani da Yustus) da kuma Mattiyas.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:24
content: 24 Sai suka yi addu’a suka ce, “Ubangiji, ka san zuciyar kowa. Nuna mana wanne a cikin waɗannan biyu da ka zaɓa

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:25
content: 25 ya karɓi wannan aikin manzanci, wanda Yahuda ya bari don yă tafi wurin da yake nasa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 1:26
content: 26 Sa’an nan suka jefa ƙuri’u, ƙuri’ar kuwa ta fāɗo a kan Mattiyas; sai aka sa shi cikin manzannin nan goma sha ɗaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:1
content: 1 Da ranar Fentekos ta yi, dukansu suna tare wuri ɗaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:2
content: 2 Ba zato ba tsammani sai aka ji motsi kamar ta babbar iska tana hurowa daga sama ta kuma cika dukan gidan da suke zaune.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:3
content: 3 Suka ga wani abin da ya yi kama da harsunan wuta, suka rarrabu suna kuma sassauka a kan kowannensu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:4
content: 4 Dukansu kuwa suka cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki suka kuma fara magana da waɗansu harsuna yadda Ruhu ya sa suka iya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:5
content: 5 To, a Urushalima akwai Yahudawa masu tsoron Allah, daga kowace ƙasa a duniya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:6
content: 6 Da suka ji wannan motsi, taro ya haɗu wuri ɗaya a ruɗe, domin kowannensu ya ji suna magana da yarensa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:7
content: 7 Cike da mamaki, suka yi tambaya suna cewa, “Ashe, duk waɗannan mutane masu magana ba Galiliyawa ba ne?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:8
content: 8 To, yaya kowannenmu yana ji suna yarensa?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:9
content: 9 Fartiyawa, Medes da Elamawa; mazaunan Mesofotamiya, Yahudiya da Kaffadokiya, Fontus da Asiya,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:10
content: 10 Firjiya da Famfiliya, Masar da sassa Libiya kusa da Sairin; baƙi daga Roma

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:11
content: 11 (Yahudawa da kuma waɗanda suka tuba suka shiga Yahudanci); Kiretawa da Larabawa, mun ji su suna shelar abubuwan banmamaki na Allah da yarenmu!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:12
content: 12 A ruɗe kuma cike da mamaki, suka tambayi junansu cewa, “Mene ne wannan yake nufi?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:13
content: 13 Duk da haka waɗansu suka yi musu ba’a suka ce, “Sun yi tatil da ruwan inabi ne.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:14
content: 14 Sai Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye tare da Sha Ɗayan nan, ya ɗaga muryarsa ya yi wa taron jawabi ya ce, “’Yan’uwana Yahudawa da dukanku da kuke zama cikin Urushalima, bari in bayyana muku wannan, ku saurara da kyau ga abin da zan faɗa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:15
content: 15 Waɗannan mutane ba su bugu ba, kamar yadda kuka ɗauka. Yanzu ƙarfe tara na safe ne kawai!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:16
content: 16 A’a, ai, abin da aka yi magana ta bakin annabi Yowel ke nan cewa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:17
content: 17 “Allah ya ce, ‘A kwanakin ƙarshe, zan zubo Ruhuna bisa dukan mutane. ’Ya’yanku maza da mata za su yi annabci, samarinku za su ga wahayoyi, dattawanku kuma za su yi mafarkai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:18
content: 18 Kai, har ma a kan bayina, maza da mata, zan zubo Ruhuna a waɗancan kwanaki, za su kuwa yi annabci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:19
content: 19 Zan nuna abubuwan banmamaki a sararin sama da alamu a nan ƙasa, jini da wuta da kuma hauhawan hayaƙi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:20
content: 20 Za a mai da rana duhu, wata kuma ya zama jini, kafin zuwa rana mai girma da kuma ta ɗaukaka ta Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:21
content: 21 Kuma duk wanda ya kira bisa sunan Ubangiji zai sami ceto.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:22
content: 22 “Mutanen Isra’ila, ku saurari wannan. Yesu Banazare shi ne mutumin da Allah ya tabbatar muku ta wurin mu’ujizai, ayyukan banmamaki, da kuma alamu, waɗanda Allah ya yi a cikinku ta wurinsa, kamar yadda ku kanku kuka sani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:23
content: 23 An ba da wannan mutum gare ku bisa ga nufin Allah da kuma rigyasaninsa, ku kuma tare da taimakon mugayen mutane, kuka kashe shi ta wurin kafa shi a kan gicciye.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:24
content: 24 Amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu, ya ’yantar da shi daga azabar mutuwa, don ba ya yiwuwa mutuwa ta riƙe shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:25
content: 25 Dawuda ya yi faɗi game da shi cewa, “ ‘Kullum ina ganin Ubangiji a gabana. Gama yana a hannuna na dama, ba zan jijjigu ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:26
content: 26 Saboda haka, zuciyata na farin ciki, harshena kuma na murna, jikina kuma zai kasance da bege,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:27
content: 27 gama ba za ka bar ni cikin kabari ba, ba kuwa za ka yarda Mai Tsarkinka yă ruɓa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:28
content: 28 Ka sanar da ni hanyoyin rai, za ka cika ni da farin ciki a gabanka.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:29
content: 29 “’Yan’uwa, zan iya tabbatar muku gabagadi cewa kakanmu Dawuda ya mutu aka kuma binne shi, kabarinsa kuwa yana a nan har yă zuwa yau.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:30
content: 30 Amma shi annabi ne ya kuma san abin da Allah ya yi masa alkawari da rantsuwa cewa zai ɗora ɗaya daga cikin zuriyarsa a kan gadon sarautarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:31
content: 31 Ganin abin da yake gaba, ya yi magana a kan tashin Kiristi daga matattu cewa, ba a bar shi a kabari ba, jikinsa kuma bai ruɓa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:32
content: 32 Allah ya tashe wannan Yesu zuwa rai, mu kuwa duk shaidu ne ga wannan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:33
content: 33 An ɗaukaka shi zuwa ga hannun dama na Allah, ya karɓi alkawarin Ruhu Mai Tsarki daga Uba, ya kuma zubo abin da yanzu kuke gani kuke kuma ji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:34
content: 34 Gama Dawuda bai hau zuwa sama ba, duk da haka ya ce, “ ‘Ubangiji ya ce wa Ubangijina, “Zauna a hannun damana,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:35
content: 35 sai na sa abokan gābanka su zama matashin sawunka.” ’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:36
content: 36 “Saboda haka bari dukan Isra’ila su tabbatar da wannan. Allah ya mai da wannan Yesu, da kuka gicciye, Ubangiji da kuma Kiristi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:37
content: 37 Sa’ad da mutane suka ji wannan, sai suka soku a zuci sai suka ce wa Bitrus da sauran manzanni, “’Yan’uwa, me za mu yi?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:38
content: 38 Bitrus ya amsa, “Ku tuba a kuma yi muku baftisma, kowannenku a cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi domin gafarar zunubanku. Za ku kuwa karɓi kyautar Ruhu Mai Tsarki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:39
content: 39 Alkawarin dominku ne da ’ya’yanku da kuma dukan waɗanda suke da nesa, domin dukan waɗanda Ubangiji Allahnmu zai kira.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:40
content: 40 Da waɗansu kalmomi masu yawa ya gargaɗe su; ya kuma roƙe su cewa, “Ku ceci kanku daga wannan lalataccen zamani.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:41
content: 41 Waɗanda suka yarda da saƙonsa kuwa aka yi musu baftisma, a ranar kuwa yawansu ya ƙaru da mutum kusan dubu uku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:42
content: 42 Suka ba da kansu ga koyarwar manzanni da kuma ga zumunci, ga gutsuttsura burodin da kuma ga addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:43
content: 43 Kowa ya cika da tsoro, manzannin kuwa suka aikata abubuwan banmamaki da alamu masu yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:44
content: 44 Dukan masu bi suna tare, suna kuma mallakar kome tare.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:45
content: 45 Suka dinga sayar da ƙaddarorinsu da kayayyakinsu, suka ba wa kowa gwargwadon bukatarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:46
content: 46 Kowace rana suka ci gaba da taruwa a filin haikali. Suka gutsuttsura burodi a gidajensu suna cin abinci tare da farin ciki da zuciya ɗaya,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 2:47
content: 47 suna yabon Allah suna kuma samun tagomashin dukan mutane. Ubangiji kuwa ya ƙara yawansu kowace rana na waɗanda suke samun ceto.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:1
content: 1 Wata rana, Bitrus da Yohanna suna haurawa zuwa haikali a lokacin addu’a da ƙarfe uku na rana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:2
content: 2 To, sai ga wani da aka haifa gurgu ana ɗauke da shi zuwa ƙofar haikalin da ake kira Kyakkyawa, inda akan ajiye kowace rana, don yă yi bara daga masu shigowa cikin filayen haikali.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:3
content: 3 Da ya ga Bitrus da Yohanna suna gab da shiga, sai ya roƙe su kuɗi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:4
content: 4 Bitrus kuwa ya kafa masa ido, haka ma Yohanna. Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Dube mu!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:5
content: 5 Saboda haka mutumin ya mai da hankalinsa a kansu, yana fata samun wani abu daga gare su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:6
content: 6 Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Azurfa ko zinariya ba ni da su, amma abin da nake da shi, shi zan ba ka. A cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi Banazare, ka yi tafiya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:7
content: 7 Ta wurin kama hannunsa na dama, ya taimake shi ya miƙe, nan take ƙafafu da idon sawun mutumin suka yi ƙarfi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:8
content: 8 Sai ya yi wuf da ƙafafunsa ya fara tafiya. Ya tafi tare da su ya shiga cikin filin haikali yana tafiya yana tsalle, yana kuma yabon Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:9
content: 9 Sa’ad da dukan mutane suka gan shi yana tafiya yana yabon Allah,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:10
content: 10 sai suka gane cewa shi ne mutumin nan wanda dā yake zama yana bara a bakin ƙofar haikalin da ake kira Kyakkyawa, suka kuwa cika da mamaki da tsoro a kan abin da ya faru gare shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:11
content: 11 Tun mai bawan yana riƙe da Bitrus da Yohanna, dukan mutanen suka yi mamaki, suka zo wurinsu a guje a inda ake kira Shirayin Solomon.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:12
content: 12 Da Bitrus ya ga haka, sai ya ce musu, “Mutanen Isra’ila, don me wannan ya ba ku mamaki? Don me kuke kallonmu sai ka ce da ikon kanmu ne ko kuwa don ibadarmu ne muka sa wannan mutum ya yi tafiya?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:13
content: 13 Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku, da Yaƙub, Allah na kakanninmu, ya ɗaukaka bawansa Yesu. Ku kuka ba da shi domin a kashe, kuka yi mūsun saninsa a gaban Bilatus, ko da yake ya yi niyya ya sake shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:14
content: 14 Kuka yi mūsun sanin Mai Tsarki da Mai Adalci kuka roƙa a sakar muku mai kisankai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:15
content: 15 Kuka kashe tushen rai, amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu. Mu shaidu ne ga wannan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:16
content: 16 Ta wurin bangaskiya cikin sunan Yesu ne wannan mutum da kuke gani kuka kuma sani ya sami ƙarfi. Da sunan Yesu, da kuma bangaskiyar da take samuwa ta wurinsa ne ya ba shi cikakkiyar warkarwa, yadda dukanku kuke gani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:17
content: 17 “To, ’yan’uwa, na san cewa, kun aikata wannan cikin jahilci ne, yadda shugabanninku suka yi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:18
content: 18 Amma ta haka ne Allah ya cika abin da ya rigyafaɗi ta bakin dukan annabawa cewa, Kiristinsa zai sha wahala.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:19
content: 19 Saboda haka ku tuba, ku juyo ga Allah, don a shafe zunubanku, don lokutan wartsakewa su zo daga wurin Ubangiji,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:20
content: 20 don kuma ya iya aika da Kiristi, wanda aka naɗa tun dā saboda ku, Yesu ke nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:21
content: 21 Dole yă kasance a sama, sai lokaci ya yi da Allah zai mai da kome sabo, yadda ya yi alkawari tun dā ta wurin annabawansa masu tsarki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:22
content: 22 Gama Musa ya ce, ‘Ubangiji Allahnku zai tasar muku wani annabi kamar ni daga cikin mutanenku; dole ku saurari duk abin da ya faɗa muku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:23
content: 23 Duk wanda bai saurare shi ba za a ware shi gaba ɗaya daga mutanensa.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:24
content: 24 “Tabbatacce, dukan annabawa daga Sama’ila zuwa gaba, dukansu da suka yi magana, sun rigya faɗin waɗannan kwanaki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:25
content: 25 Ku kuwa magādan annabawan ne da kuma na alkawarin da Allah ya yi da kakanninku. Ya ce wa Ibrahim, ‘Ta wurin zuriyarka, dukan kabilan duniya za su sami albarka.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 3:26
content: 26 Da Allah ya tashe bawansa, ya aike shi da fari zuwa gare ku don yă albarkace ku ta wurin juye kowannenku daga mugayen hanyoyinku.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:1
content: 1 Sai firistoci da shugaban masu gadin haikalin da kuma Sadukiyawa suka hauro wurin Bitrus da Yohanna yayinda suke cikin magana da mutane.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:2
content: 2 Sun damu ƙwarai da gaske domin manzannin suna koya wa mutane suna kuma shela a cikin Yesu cewa akwai tashin matattu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:3
content: 3 Sai suka kama Bitrus da Yohanna, amma da yake yamma ta riga ta yi sai suka sa su cikin kurkuku sai kashegari.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:4
content: 4 Amma da yawa da suka ji saƙon suka gaskata, yawan mutanen kuwa ya ƙaru ya kai wajen dubu biyar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:5
content: 5 Kashegari, sai masu mulki, dattawa da kuma malaman dokoki suka taru a Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:6
content: 6 Annas babban firist yana nan, haka ma Kayifas Yohanna, Alekzanda da kuma sauran mutanen da suke iyalin babban firist.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:7
content: 7 Suka sa aka kawo Bitrus da Yohanna a gabansu suka kuma fara yin musu tambayoyi cewa, “Da wane iko ko da wane suna kuka yi wannan?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:8
content: 8 Sai Bitrus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce musu, “Masu mulki da dattawan mutane!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:9
content: 9 In ana tuhumarmu ne yau saboda alherin da aka yi wa gurgun nan da kuma yadda aka warkar da shi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:10
content: 10 to, sai ku san wannan, ku da dukan mutanen Isra’ila cewa da sunan Yesu Kiristi Banazare, wanda kuka gicciye amma wanda Allah ya tasar daga matattu ne, wannan mutum yake tsaye a gabanku lafiyayye.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:11
content: 11 Shi ne, “ ‘dutsen da ku magina kuka ƙi, wanda kuwa ya zama dutsen kusurwar gini.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:12
content: 12 Ba a samun ceto ta wurin wani dabam, gama babu wani suna a ƙarƙashin sama da aka ba wa mutane wanda ta wurinsa dole mu sami ceto.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:13
content: 13 Da suka ga ƙarfin halin Bitrus da Yohanna suka kuma gane cewa su marasa ilimi ne, talakawa kuma, sai suka yi mamaki suka kuma lura cewa waɗannan mutane sun kasance tare da Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:14
content: 14 Amma da yake sun ga mutumin da aka warkar yana tsaye a wurin tare da su, sai suka rasa abin faɗi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:15
content: 15 Saboda haka suka umarta a fitar da su daga Majalisar, sa’an nan suka yi shawara da juna.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:16
content: 16 Suka ce, “Me za mu yi da waɗannan mutane? Kowa da yake zama a Urushalima ya san sun yi abin banmamaki, kuma ba za mu iya yin mūsu wannan ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:17
content: 17 Amma don a hana wannan abu daga ƙara bazuwa cikin mutane, dole mu kwaɓe mutanen nan kada su ƙara yi wa kowa magana cikin wannan suna.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:18
content: 18 Sai suka sāke kiransu ciki suka kuma umarce su kada su kuskura su yi magana ko su ƙara koyarwa a cikin sunan Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:19
content: 19 Amma Bitrus da Yohanna suka amsa, “Ku shari’anta da kanku ko daidai ne a gaban Allah mu yi muku biyayya maimakon Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:20
content: 20 Gama ba za mu iya daina yin magana game da abin da muka gani muka kuma ji ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:21
content: 21 Bayan ƙarin barazana sai suka bar su su tafi. Ba su iya yanke shawara yadda za a hore su ba, domin dukan mutane suna yabon Allah saboda abin da ya faru.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:22
content: 22 Gama mutumin da ya sami warkarwar banmamaki, shekarunsa sun fi arba’in.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:23
content: 23 Da aka sake su, Bitrus da Yohanna suka koma wajen mutanensu suka ba da labarin duk abin da manyan firistoci da dattawa suka faɗa musu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:24
content: 24 Sa’ad da suka ji wannan, sai suka ɗaga muryoyinsu gaba ɗaya cikin addu’a ga Allah, suka ce, “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kai ka halicci sama da ƙasa da kuma teku, da kome da yake cikinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:25
content: 25 Ka yi magana ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki ta bakin bawanka, kakanmu Dawuda cewa, “ ‘Don me ƙasashe suke fushi, mutane kuma suke ƙulla shawara a banza?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:26
content: 26 Sarakunan duniya sun ja dāgā, masu mulki kuma sun taru gaba ɗaya, suna gāba da Ubangiji da kuma Shafaffensa.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:27
content: 27 Tabbatacce Hiridus da Buntus Bilatus suka haɗu tare da Al’ummai da kuma mutanen Isra’ila a wannan birni ce don su ƙulla gāba da bawanka mai tsarki Yesu, wanda ka shafe.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:28
content: 28 Sun aikata abin da ikonka da kuma nufinka ya riga ya shirya tuntuni zai faru.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:29
content: 29 Yanzu, Ubangiji, ka dubi barazanansu ka kuma sa bayinka su furta maganarka da iyakar ƙarfin hali.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:30
content: 30 Ka miƙa hannunka don ka warkar ka kuma yi ayyukan banmamaki da alamu masu banmamaki ta wurin sunan bawanka mai tsarki Yesu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:31
content: 31 Bayan suka yi addu’a, sai inda suka taru ya jijjigu. Dukansu kuwa suka cika da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, suka yi ta shaidar maganar Allah babu tsoro.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:32
content: 32 Dukan masu bi kuwa zuciyarsu ɗaya ne, nufinsu kuwa ɗaya. Babu wani da ya ce abin da ya mallaka nasa ne, amma sun raba kome da suke da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:33
content: 33 Da iko mai ƙarfi manzanni suka ci gaba da shaidar tashin matattu na Ubangiji Yesu, alheri mai yawa kuwa yana bisansu duka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:34
content: 34 Babu mabukata a cikinsu. Lokaci-lokaci waɗanda suke da gonaki ko gidaje sukan sayar da su, su kawo kuɗi daga abin da suka sayar,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:35
content: 35 su ajiye a sawun manzannin, a kuma raba wa kowa gwargwadon bukatarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:36
content: 36 Yusuf, wani Balawe daga Saifurus, wanda manzanni suke kira Barnabas (wanda yake nufin Ɗan Ƙarfafawa)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 4:37
content: 37 ya sayar da wata gonar da ya mallaki ya kuma kawo kuɗin ya ajiye a sawun manzanni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:1
content: 1 To wani mutum mai suna Ananiyas tare da matarsa Saffiratu, shi ma ya sayar da wata mallakarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:2
content: 2 Da cikakken sanin matarsa ya ajiye sashi daga cikin kuɗin don kansa, ya kuma kawo sauran ya ajiye a sawun manzanni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:3
content: 3 Sai Bitrus ya ce, “Ananiyas, ta yaya Shaiɗan ya cika zuciyarka haka da ka yi wa Ruhu Mai Tsarki ƙarya ka kuma ajiye wa kanka sauran kuɗin da ka karɓa na filin?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:4
content: 4 Ba naka ba ne kafin ka sayar da shi? Bayan da ka sayar da shi kuma, kuɗin ba naka ba ne? Me ya sa ka yi tunanin yin irin wannan abu? Ba mutum ne ka yi wa ƙarya ba, Allah ne ka yi masa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:5
content: 5 Da Ananiyas ya ji wannan, sai ya fāɗi ya mutu. Sai babban tsoro kuwa ya kama duk waɗanda suka ji abin da ya faru.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:6
content: 6 Sai samari suka zo gaba, suka naɗe gawarsa, suka fitar da shi suka je suka binne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:7
content: 7 Bayan kusan awa uku, sai matarsa ta shigo, ba da sanin abin da ya faru ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:8
content: 8 Bitrus ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Gaya mini, kuɗin da yake da Ananiyas kuka sayar da filin ke nan?” Ta ce, “I, haka ne muka sayar.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:9
content: 9 Bitrus ya ce mata, “Ta yaya kuka yarda ku gwada Ruhun Ubangiji? Duba! Sawun mutanen da suka binne mijinki suna bakin ƙofa, za su kuwa ɗauke ki zuwa waje ke ma.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:10
content: 10 Nan take ta fāɗi a ƙafafunsa ta mutu. Sai samarin suka shigo ciki, suka kuwa same ta matacciya, suka ɗauke ta suka kai ta waje suka binne ta kusa da mijinta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:11
content: 11 Babban tsoro ya kama dukan ikkilisiya da kuma duk wanda ya ji game da abubuwan nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:12
content: 12 Manzannin suka yi ayyukan da alamu masu banmamaki masu yawa a cikin mutanen. Dukan masu bi kuwa sukan taru a Shirayin Solomon.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:13
content: 13 Ba wanda ya yi karambanin shiga cikinsu, duk da haka mutane suna girmama su ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:14
content: 14 Duk da haka, maza da matan da suke gaskata ga Ubangiji sai ƙaruwa suke, suka kuma ƙaru a yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:15
content: 15 A sakamakon haka, mutane suka kawo marasa lafiya a tituna suka kwantar da su a kan gadaje da tabarmai domin aƙalla inuwar Bitrus za tă bi kan waɗansunsu yayinda yake wucewa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:16
content: 16 Jama’a ma suka tattaru daga garuruwa kewaye da Urushalima suna kawo marasa lafiyarsu da kuma waɗanda mugayen ruhohi suke damun su, dukansu kuwa suka warke.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:17
content: 17 Sai babban firist da dukan abokan aikinsa, waɗanda suke na ƙungiyar Sadukiyawa suka cika da kishi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:18
content: 18 Suka kama manzannin suka sa su a kurkukun da ake sa kowa da kowa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:19
content: 19 Amma da dare wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya buɗe ƙofofin kurkukun ya fitar da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:20
content: 20 Ya ce, “Ku je ku tsaya a filin haikali ku sanar wa mutane cikakken saƙon wannan sabon rai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:21
content: 21 Da gari ya waye, sai suka shiga filin haikali, yadda aka faɗa musu, suka kuwa fara koyar da mutane. Sa’ad da babban firist da abokan aikinsa suka iso, sai suka kira Majalisa gaba ɗaya dukan dattawan Isra’ila, suka kuma aika kurkuku a zo da manzannin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:22
content: 22 Amma da dogarawan suka iso kurkukun, ba su same su a can ba. Saboda haka suka dawo suka ba da labari, suka ce,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:23
content: 23 “Mun iske kurkukun a kulle sosai, da masu gadi suna tsaye a bakin ƙofofin; amma da muka buɗe su, sai muka tarar ba kowa a ciki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:24
content: 24 Da jin wannan labari, sai shugaban masu gadin haikali da manyan firistocin suka ruɗe, suna tunanin abin da wannan al’amari zai zama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:25
content: 25 Sai wani ya zo ya ce, “Ga shi! Mutanen da kuka sa a kurkuku suna tsaye a filin haikali suna koya wa mutane.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:26
content: 26 Da wannan, shugaban ya tafi tare da dogarawansa suka kawo manzannin. Sun kawo su amma fa ba ƙarfi da yaji ba, don suna tsoro kada mutane su jajjefe su da duwatsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:27
content: 27 Da suka kawo manzannin, sai suka sa su suka bayyana a gaban Majalisar don babban firist ya tuhume su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:28
content: 28 Ya ce, “Mun kwaɓe ku da gaske kada ku ƙara koyarwa cikin wannan suna, duk da haka kun cika Urushalima da koyarwarku, har ma kuna so ku ɗora mana laifin jinin mutumin nan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:29
content: 29 Bitrus da sauran manzannin suka amsa suka ce, “Dole ne mu yi wa Allah biyayya a maimakon mutane!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:30
content: 30 Allahn kakanninmu ya tā da Yesu daga matattu, wanda kuka kashe ta wurin ratayewa a bisan itace.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:31
content: 31 Allah ya ɗaukaka shi zuwa hannun damansa a matsayin Yerima da Mai Ceto don yă kawo tuba da gafarar zunubai ga Isra’ila.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:32
content: 32 Mu shaidu ne ga waɗannan abubuwa, haka kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki, wanda Allah ya ba wa waɗanda suke yin masa biyayya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:33
content: 33 Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi suka so su kashe su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:34
content: 34 Amma wani Bafarisiyen da ake kira Gamaliyel, wani malamin doka, wanda dukan mutane ke girmamawa, ya miƙe tsaye a Majalisar ya umarta a fitar da mutanen waje na ɗan lokaci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:35
content: 35 Sa’an nan ya yi musu jawabi ya ce, “Mutanen Isra’ila, ku yi kula da kyau da abin da kuke niyyar yi wa mutanen nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:36
content: 36 Kwanan baya, Teyudas ya ɓullo, yana cewa wai shi wani mutum ne, kuma wajen mutane ɗari huɗu suka bi shi. Aka kuwa kashe shi, dukan masu binsa kuwa suka watse, kome ya wargaje.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:37
content: 37 Bayansa, Yahuda mutumin Galili ya ɓullo a kwanakin ƙidaya, ya jagoranci mutane cikin tawaye. Shi ma aka kashe shi, dukan mabiyansa kuma aka watsar da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:38
content: 38 Saboda haka, a wannan batu na yanzu, ina ba ku shawara. Ku ƙyale mutanen nan! Ku bar su su tafi! Gama in manufarsu ko ayyukansu na mutum ne, ai, zai rushe.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:39
content: 39 Amma in daga Allah ne, ba za ku iya hana waɗannan mutane ba, za ku dai sami kanku kuna gāba da Allah ne.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:40
content: 40 Jawabinsa ya rinjaye su. Suka kira manzannin suka sa aka yi musu bulala. Sa’an nan suka kwaɓe su kada su ƙara magana a cikin sunan Yesu, suka kuma bar su suka tafi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:41
content: 41 Manzannin suka bar Majalisar, suna farin ciki domin an ga sun cancanta a kunyata su saboda Sunan nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 5:42
content: 42 Kowace rana, a filin haikali da kuma gida-gida, ba su fasa koyarwa da kuma shelar labari mai daɗi cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:1
content: 1 A waɗannan kwanaki, sa’ad da yawan almajirai suke ƙaruwa, sai Yahudawan masu jin Hellenanci a cikinsu suka yi gunaguni a kan Yahudawan da suke Ibraniyawa domin ba a kula da gwaurayensu a wajen raba abinci na yau da kullum.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:2
content: 2 Saboda haka Sha Biyun nan suka tara dukan almajirai wuri ɗaya, suka ce, “Bai zai yi kyau mu bar hidimar maganar Allah don mu shiga hidimar abinci ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:3
content: 3 ’Yan’uwa, ku zaɓi mutum bakwai daga cikinku waɗanda aka sani suna cike da Ruhu da kuma hikima. Mu kuwa za mu danƙa musu wannan aiki

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:4
content: 4 mu kuwa mu mai da halinmu ga yin addu’a da kuma hidimar maganar Allah.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:5
content: 5 Wannan shawarar kuwa ta gamshi dukan ƙungiyar. Sai suka zaɓi Istifanus, mutumin da yake cike da bangaskiya da kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki; da Filibus, Burokorus, Nikano, Timon, Farmenas, da Nikolas daga Antiyok, wanda ya tuba zuwa Yahudanci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:6
content: 6 Suka gabatar da waɗannan mutane wa manzanni, waɗanda kuwa suka yi addu’a, suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:7
content: 7 Saboda haka maganar Allah ta yaɗu. Yawan almajirai a Urushalima kuwa ya yi saurin ƙaruwa, firistoci masu yawa kuma suka zama masu biyayya ga wannan bangaskiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:8
content: 8 To, Istifanus, mutum cike da alheri da ikon Allah, ya aikata manyan ayyukan da alamu masu banmamaki a cikin mutane.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:9
content: 9 Sai hamayya ta taso daga ’yan ƙungiyar Majami’a na ’Yantattu (kamar yadda ake kiransu), Yahudawan Sairin da Alekzandariya da kuma lardunan Silisiya da Asiya. Mutanen nan suka fara muhawwara da Istifanus,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:10
content: 10 amma ba su iya cin nasara kan hikimarsa ko kuma a kan Ruhu wanda ta wurinsa ne ya magana ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:11
content: 11 Sa’an nan a asirce suka zuga waɗansu mutane su ce, “Mun ji Istifanus ya faɗa kalmomin saɓo game da Musa da kuma Allah.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:12
content: 12 Ta haka suka tā da hankalin mutane da dattawa da kuma malaman dokoki. Suka kama Istifanus suka kawo shi a gaban Majalisa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:13
content: 13 Suka kawo masu ba da shaidar ƙarya, waɗanda suka ba da shaida cewa, “Wannan mutum ba ya rabuwa da maganar banza a kan wurin nan mai tsarki da kuma doka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:14
content: 14 Gama mun ji shi yana cewa wannan Yesu Banazare zai rushe wurin nan ya kuma canja al’adun da Musa ya ba mu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 6:15
content: 15 Dukan waɗanda suke zaune a Majalisar suka kafa wa Istifanus ido, suka kuma ga fuskarsa ta yi kama da ta mala’ika.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:1
content: 1 Sai babban firist ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Waɗannan zargen gaskiya ne?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:2
content: 2 Game da wannan ya amsa ya ce, “’Yan’uwa da ubanni, ku saurare ni! Allah mai ɗaukaka ya bayyana ga kakanmu Ibrahim yayinda yake a ƙasar Mesofotamiya tukuna, kafin ya yi zama a Haran.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:3
content: 3 Allah ya ce, ‘Ka bar ƙasarka da kuma mutanenka, ka tafi ƙasar da zan nuna maka.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:4
content: 4 “Saboda haka ya bar ƙasar Kaldiyawa ya kuma yi zama a Haran. Bayan mutuwar mahaifinsa, Allah ya aika da shi wannan ƙasar da yanzu kuke zama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:5
content: 5 Bai ba shi gādo a nan ba, ko taki ɗaya na ƙasa. Amma Allah ya yi masa alkawari cewa shi da zuriyarsa masu zuwa bayansa za su mallaki ƙasar, ko da yake a lokacin Ibrahim ba shi da yaro.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:6
content: 6 Allah ya yi magana da shi ta haka, ‘Shekara ɗari huɗu, zuriyarka za tă yi baƙunci a wata ƙasar da ba tasu ba, za su yi bauta su kuma sha wulaƙanci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:7
content: 7 Amma zan hore ƙasar da suka bauta wa.’ Allah ya ce, ‘Kuma daga baya za su fita daga wannan ƙasa su kuma yi mini sujada a wannan wuri.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:8
content: 8 Sa’an nan ya yi wa Ibrahim alkawari game da kaciya. Ibrahim kuwa ya zama mahaifin Ishaku ya kuma yi masa kaciya kwana takwas bayan haihuwarsa. Daga baya Ishaku ya zama mahaifin Yaƙub, Yaƙub kuma ya zama mahaifin kakanninmu sha biyun nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:9
content: 9 “Domin kakanninmu sun ji kishin Yusuf, sai suka sayar da shi bawa zuwa Masar. Amma Allah ya kasance tare da shi

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:10
content: 10 ya kuma cece shi daga dukan wahalolinsa. Ya ba wa Yusuf hikima ya kuma sa ya sami farin jini a wurin Fir’auna, sarkin Masar; saboda haka ya mai da shi mai mulki a kan Masar da kuma dukan fadarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:11
content: 11 “Sai yunwa ta auko wa dukan Masar da Kan’ana, ta kawo wahala mai tsanani, kakanninmu ba su iya samun abinci ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da Yaƙub ya ji cewa akwai hatsi a Masar, sai ya aiki kakanninmu ziyararsu ta farko.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:13
content: 13 A ziyararsu ta biyu, Yusuf ya faɗa wa ’yan’uwansa wane ne shi, Fir’auna kuwa ya sami sani game da iyalin Yusuf.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:14
content: 14 Bayan wannan, Yusuf ya aika a zo da mahaifinsa Yaƙub da dukan iyalinsa, gaba ɗaya dai mutum saba’in da biyar ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:15
content: 15 Sai Yaƙub ya gangara zuwa Masar, inda shi da kuma kakanninmu suka mutu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:16
content: 16 Aka dawo da gawawwakinsu Shekem aka binne su a kabarin da Ibrahim ya saya daga wurin ’ya’yan Hamor da waɗansu kuɗi a Shekem.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:17
content: 17 “Da lokaci ya yi kusa da Allah zai cika alkawarin da ya yi wa Ibrahim, sai yawan mutanenmu da suke a Masar ya ƙaru ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:18
content: 18 Sa’an nan wani sarki, wanda bai san kome game da Yusuf ba, ya zama mai mulkin Masar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:19
content: 19 Ya kuwa wulaƙanta mutanenmu sosai, ya kuma gwada wa kakanni-kakanninmu azaba ta wurin tilasta su su zubar da sababbin jariransu, don su mutu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:20
content: 20 “A lokacin nan aka haifi Musa, shi kuwa ba kamar sauran jarirai ba ne. Wata uku aka yi renonsa a gidan mahaifinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:21
content: 21 Sa’ad da aka ajiye shi a waje, diyar Fir’auna ta ɗauke shi ta kuma rene shi kamar ɗanta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:22
content: 22 Musa ya sami ilimi cikin dukan hikimar Masarawa ya kuma zama mai iko cikin magana da ayyuka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:23
content: 23 “Da Musa ya cika shekara arba’in da haihuwa, sai ya yanke shawara yă ziyarci ’yan’uwansa Isra’ilawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:24
content: 24 Ya ga ɗayansu yana shan wulaƙanci a hannun wani mutumin Masar, sai ya je ya kāre shi, ya rama masa ta wurin kashe mutumin Masar ɗin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:25
content: 25 Musa ya yi tsammani mutanensa za su gane cewa, Allah yana amfani da shi don yă cece su, amma ba su gane ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:26
content: 26 Kashegari, Musa ya sadu da Isra’ilawa biyu suna faɗa. Ya yi ƙoƙari ya sasanta su, yana cewa, ‘Ku mutane, ku ’yan’uwa ne, don me kuke so ku cutar da juna?’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:27
content: 27 “Amma mutumin da yake wulaƙanta ɗayan, ya tura Musa a gefe ya ce, ‘Wa ya mai da kai mai mulki, da alƙali a kanmu?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:28
content: 28 Kana so ka kashe ni kamar yadda ka kashe mutumin Masar nan na jiya?’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:29
content: 29 Sa’ad da Musa ya ji haka, sai ya gudu zuwa ƙasar Midiyan, inda ya yi baƙunci, ya kuma haifi ’ya’ya biyu maza.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:30
content: 30 “Bayan shekaru arba’in suka wuce, sai mala’ika ya bayyana ga Musa cikin harshen wuta a ɗan itace a hamada kusa da Dutsen Sinai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:31
content: 31 Sa’ad da ya ga haka, ya yi mamakin abin da ya gani. Da ya yi kusa domin ya duba sosai, sai ya ji muryar Ubangiji ta ce,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:32
content: 32 ‘Ni ne Allahn kakanninka, Allah na Ibrahim, Ishaku, da kuma Yaƙub.’ Sai Musa ya yi rawan jiki don tsoro, bai kuwa yi karambanin dubawa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:33
content: 33 “Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce masa, ‘Ka cire takalmanka; wurin da kake tsayen nan mai tsarki ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:34
content: 34 Tabbatacce na ga wulaƙancin da ake yi wa mutanena a Masar. Na ji nishinsu na kuma sauka domin in ’yantar da su. Yanzu ka zo, zan aike ka ka koma Masar.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:35
content: 35 “Wannan Musa ɗin da suka ƙi suna cewa, ‘Wa ya mai da kai mai mulki da kuma alƙali?’ Allah da kansa ya aike shi, ta wurin mala’ikan da ya bayyana a gare shi a ɗan itace, yă zama mai mulkinsu, da kuma mai cetonsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:36
content: 36 Ya fitar da su daga Masar ya kuma yi ayyukan da abubuwan banmamaki a Masar, a Jan Teku, da kuma cikin hamada har shekara arba’in.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:37
content: 37 “Wannan Musa ne ya ce Isra’ilawa, ‘Allah zai aika muku wani annabi kamar ni daga cikin mutanenku.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:38
content: 38 Ya kasance a cikin taron nan a hamada, tare da mala’ikan da ya yi magana da shi a Dutsen Sinai, da kuma tare da kakanninmu; ya kuma karɓi kalmomi masu rai don yă miƙa mana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:39
content: 39 “Amma kakanninmu suka ƙi yin masa biyayya. A maimakon haka, sai suka ƙi shi a cikin zuciyarsu kuwa suka koma Masar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:40
content: 40 Suka ce wa Haruna, ‘Ka yi mana allolin da za su yi mana jagora. Game da wannan Musa ɗin wanda ya fitar da mu daga Masar, ba mu san abin da ya faru da shi ba!’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:41
content: 41 A lokacin ne suka ƙera gunki mai siffar ɗan maraƙi. Suka kawo masa hadayu suka kuma yi bikin girmama abin da suka ƙera da hannuwansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:42
content: 42 Sai Amma Allah ya juya musu baya ya kuma ba da su ga bautar abubuwan da suke a sararin sama. Wannan ya yi daidai da abin da yake a rubuce a cikin littafin annabawa cewa, “ ‘Kun kawo mini hadayu da sadakoki shekaru arba’in cikin, hamada, ya gidan Isra’ila?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:43
content: 43 Kun ɗaukaka gidan tsafin Molek, da tauraron allahnku Refan, gumakan da kuka ƙera don ku yi musu sujada. Saboda haka zan aike ku zuwa bauta’ gaba da Babilon.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:44
content: 44 “Kakanni-kakanninmu suna da tabanakul na Shaida tare da su a hamada. An yi shi bisa ga yadda Allah ya umarci Musa, bisa ga zānen da ya gani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:45
content: 45 Bayan sun gāji tabanakul nan, kakanninmu a ƙarƙashin jagorancin Yoshuwa suka kawo shi tare da su, lokacin da suka ƙwace ƙasar daga al’umman da Allah ya kora a idanunsu. Tabanakul ɗin ya kasance a ƙasar har zamanin Dawuda,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:46
content: 46 wanda ya sami tagomashi daga Allah, ya kuma nemi yă yi wa Allah na Yaƙub wurin zama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:47
content: 47 Amma Solomon ne ya gina masa gida.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:48
content: 48 “Duk da haka, Mafi Ɗaukaka ba ya zama a gidajen da mutane suka gina. Kamar yadda annabi ya faɗi cewa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:49
content: 49 “ ‘Sama ne kursiyina, duniya kuma wurin ajiye tafin ƙafata. Wane irin gida za ka gina mini? Ko kuwa ina wurin hutuna zai kasance? In ji Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:50
content: 50 Ba hannuna ne ya yi dukan waɗannan abubuwa ba?’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:51
content: 51 “Ku mutane masu taurinkai, da zukata da kuma kunnuwa marasa kaciya! Kuna kama da kakanninku. Kullum kuna tsayayya da Ruhu Mai Tsarki!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:52
content: 52 An yi wani annabin da kakanninku ba su tsananta wa ba? Sun ma kashe waɗanda suka yi maganar zuwan Mai Adalcin nan. Yanzu kuwa kun bashe shi kuka kuma kashe shi

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:53
content: 53 ku da kuka karɓi dokar da aka sa a aiki ta wurin mala’iku amma ba ku yi biyayya da ita ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:54
content: 54 Da membobin Sanhedrin suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi suka ciji haƙoransu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:55
content: 55 Amma Istifanus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya dubi sama ya kuma ga ɗaukakar Allah, da Yesu kuma tsaye a hannun dama na Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:56
content: 56 Ya ce, “Ga shi, na ga sama a buɗe da kuma Ɗan Mutum tsaye a hannun dama na Allah.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:57
content: 57 Da jin haka sai suka tattoshe kunnuwansu, suka kuma yi ihu da ƙarfi sosai, suka aukar masa gaba ɗaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:58
content: 58 Suka ja shi zuwa bayan birnin suka kuma yi ta jifansa da duwatsu. Ana cikin haka, shaidun suka ajiye tufafinsu a wurin wani saurayi mai suna Shawulu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:59
content: 59 Yayinda suke cikin jifansa, sai Istifanus ya yi addu’a ya ce, “Ubangiji Yesu, ka karɓi ruhuna.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 7:60
content: 60 Sa’an nan ya durƙusa ya ɗaga murya ya ce, “Ubangiji, kada ka riƙe wannan zunubi a kansu.” Da ya faɗi haka, sai ya yi barci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:1
content: 1 Shawulu kuwa yana can, yana tabbatar da mutuwarsa. A wannan rana wani babban tsanani ya auka wa ikkilisiyar da take a Urushalima, sai duka suka warwatsu ko’ina a Yahudiya da Samariya, manzanni kaɗai ne suka rage.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:2
content: 2 Mutane masu tsoron Allah suka binne Istifanus suka kuma yi makoki ƙwarai dominsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:3
content: 3 Amma Shawulu ya fara hallaka ikkilisiya. Yana shiga gida-gida, yana jan maza da mata yana jefa su cikin kurkuku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:4
content: 4 Waɗanda aka wartsar suka yi ta wa’azin maganar a duk inda suka tafi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:5
content: 5 Filibus ya gangara zuwa wani birni a Samariya ya kuma yi shelar Kiristi a can.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:6
content: 6 Sa’ad da taron mutane suka ji Filibus suka kuma ga abubuwan banmamakin da ya yi, sai duk suka mai da hankali sosai ga abin da ya faɗa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:7
content: 7 Mugayen ruhohi suka fiffito suna kururuwa daga cikin mutane da yawa, shanyayyu da guragu masu yawa suka sami warkarwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:8
content: 8 Saboda haka aka yi farin ciki ƙwarai a birnin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:9
content: 9 To, akwai wani mutum mai suna Siman wanda ya kwana biyu yana yin sihiri a birnin har ya ba wa duk mutanen Samariya mamaki. Ya kuma yi taƙama cewa shi wani mai girma ne,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:10
content: 10 dukan mutane kuwa, manyan da ƙanana, suka mai da hankali gare shi suka kuma ce, “Mutumin nan shi ne ikon Allah da aka sani a matsayin Iko Mai Girma”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:11
content: 11 Suka bi shi domin ya daɗe yana ba su mamaki da sihirinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:12
content: 12 Amma da suka gaskata da Filibus sa’ad da yake wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin Allah da kuma sunan Yesu Kiristi, sai aka yi musu baftisma, maza da mata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:13
content: 13 Siman kansa ya gaskata aka kuma yi masa baftisma. Ya kuma bi Filibus ko’ina, yana mamakin manyan alamu da ayyukan banmamakin da ya gani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:14
content: 14 Sa’ad da manzannin da suke a Urushalima suka ji cewa Samariya ta karɓi maganar Allah, sai suka aika musu da Bitrus da Yohanna.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:15
content: 15 Da suka iso, sai suka yi musu addu’a domin su karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:16
content: 16 domin Ruhu Mai Tsarki bai riga ya sauka wa waninsu ba tukuna, an dai yi musu baftisma ne kawai a cikin sunan Ubangiji Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:17
content: 17 Sa’an nan Bitrus da Yohanna suka ɗibiya hannuwansu a kansu, suka kuwa karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:18
content: 18 Sa’ad da Siman ya ga cewa ana ba da Ruhu ta wurin ɗibiya hannuwan manzannin, sai ya miƙa musu kuɗi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:19
content: 19 ya ce, “Ni ma ku ba ni wannan iyawa don kowa na ɗibiya wa hannuwana yă karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:20
content: 20 Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Bari kuɗinka ya hallaka tare da kai, domin ka yi tsammani za ka iya saya kyautar Allah da kuɗi!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:21
content: 21 Ba ruwanka da wannan hidimar, domin zuciyarka ba daidai take a gaban Allah ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:22
content: 22 Ka tuba daga wannan mugunta ka kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji. Wataƙila zai gafarta maka don irin tunanin da yake a zuciyarka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:23
content: 23 Gama na lura kana cike da ɗacin rai kana kuma daure cikin zunubi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:24
content: 24 Sai Siman ya amsa ya ce, “Ku yi addu’a ga Ubangiji saboda ni don kada ko ɗaya daga cikin abin da ka faɗa ya same ni.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:25
content: 25 Sa’ad da suka yi shaidar suka kuma yi shelar maganar Ubangiji, sai Bitrus da Yohanna suka koma Urushalima, suna wa’azin bishara a ƙauyukan Samariya masu yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:26
content: 26 To wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya ce wa Filibus, “Ka yi kudu zuwa hanyar, hanyar hamada, da ta gangara daga Urushalima zuwa Gaza.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:27
content: 27 Saboda haka ya kama hanya, a kan hanyarsa kuwa sai ya sadu da wani mutumin Itiyofiya, wanda yake bābā, hafsa mai muhimmanci wanda yake lura da dukan ma’ajin Kandas (wanda yake nufin “sarauniyar mutanen Itiyofiya”). Mutumin nan ya tafi Urushalima ne domin yin sujada,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:28
content: 28 a kan hanyarsa ta komawa gida kuwa yana zaune bisan keken yaƙinsa yana karatun littafin annabin Ishaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:29
content: 29 Sai Ruhu ya ce wa Filibus, “Matsa wurin kekunan yaƙin nan ka yi kusa da ita.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:30
content: 30 Sai Filibus ya ruga zuwa wajen keken yaƙin ya kuma ji mutumin yana karatun littafin annabin Ishaya. Filibus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ka fahimci abin da kake karantawa?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:31
content: 31 Sai ya ce, “Ina fa zan iya, in ba dai wani ya fassara mini ba?” Saboda haka sai ya gayyaci Filibus yă hau yă zauna tare da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:32
content: 32 Bābān yana karanta wannan Nassin, “An ja shi kamar tunkiya zuwa mayanka, kuma kamar ɗan rago a hannun mai askin gashinsa yake shiru, haka kuwa bai buɗe bakinsa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:33
content: 33 A cikin wulaƙacinsa aka hana masa gaskiya. Wa zai iya yin zancen zuriyarsa? Gama an ɗauke ransa daga duniya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:34
content: 34 Sai bābān ya tambayi Filibus ya ce, “Ka gaya mini, ina roƙonka, annabin yana magana a kan wane ne, kansa ne, ko kuwa wani dabam?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:35
content: 35 Sa’an nan Filibus ya fara da wannan Nassi ɗin ya kuma faɗa masa labari mai daɗi game da Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:36
content: 36 Yayinda suke cikin tafiya a kan hanya, sai suka iso wani wurin ruwa bābān nan ya ce, “Duba, ga ruwa. Me zai hana a yi mini baftisma?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:38
content: 38 Ya kuwa ba da umarni a tsai da keken yaƙin. Sa’an nan da Filibus da bābān suka gangara zuwa cikin ruwan Filibus kuwa ya yi masa baftisma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:39
content: 39 Sa’ad da suka fita daga cikin ruwan, sai Ruhun Ubangiji ya fyauce Filibus, bābān kuwa bai ƙara ganinsa ba, amma ya ci gaba da tafiyarsa yana farin ciki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 8:40
content: 40 Filibus kuwa ya fito a Azotus, ya yi ta zagawa, yana wa’azin bishara a dukan garuruwan sai da ya kai Kaisariya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:1
content: 1 Ana cikin haka, Shawulu ya ɗage yana barazana yin kisa da tsananta wa almajiran Ubangiji. Sai ya je wurin babban firist

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:2
content: 2 ya roƙe shi ya ba shi wasiƙu zuwa majami’un Damaskus, don in ya sami wani a wurin wanda yake bin wannan Hanya, ko maza ko mata, yă kama su a matsayin ’yan kurkuku yă kai Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:3
content: 3 Da ya yi kusa da Damaskus a kan hanyarsa, ba zato ba tsammani sai wani haske daga sama ya haskaka kewaye da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:4
content: 4 Sai ya fāɗi a ƙasa ya kuma ji wata murya ta ce masa, “Shawulu, Shawulu, don me kake tsananta mini?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:5
content: 5 Shawulu ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Ni ne Yesu wanda kake tsananta wa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:6
content: 6 Yanzu ka tashi ka shiga cikin birnin, za a kuma gaya maka abin da dole za ka yi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:7
content: 7 Mutanen da suke tafiya tare da Shawulu suka rasa bakin magana; sun ji muryar amma ba su ga kowa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:8
content: 8 Shawulu ya tashi daga ƙasa, amma sa’ad da ya buɗe idanunsa bai iya ganin wani abu ba. Saboda haka aka kama hannunsa aka yi masa jagora zuwa cikin Damaskus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:9
content: 9 Kwana uku yana a makance, bai ci ba bai kuma sha kome ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:10
content: 10 A Damaskus kuwa akwai wani almajiri mai suna Ananiyas. Ubangiji ya kira shi a cikin wahayi ya ce, “Ananiyas!” Ananiyas ya amsa, “Ga ni, ya Ubangiji.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:11
content: 11 Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Je gidan Yahuda da yake a Miƙaƙƙen Titi ka yi tambaya ko akwai wani mutum daga Tarshish mai suna Shawulu, gama ga shi yana addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:12
content: 12 Cikin wahayi ya ga wani mutum mai suna Ananiyas ya zo ya sa hannuwansa a kansa don yă sāke samun ganin gari.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:13
content: 13 Ananiyas ya amsa ya ce, “Ubangiji, na ji labarin mutumin nan sosai da kuma duk lahanin da ya yi wa tsarkakanka a Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:14
content: 14 Ga shi kuma ya zo nan da izinin manyan firistoci, don yă kama duk wanda yake kiran bisa sunanka.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:15
content: 15 Amma Ubangiji ya ce wa Ananiyas, “Je ka! Wannan mutum zaɓaɓɓen kayan aikina ne don yă kai sunana a gaban Al’ummai da sarakunansu da kuma a gaban mutanen Isra’ila.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:16
content: 16 Zan nuna masa wahalar da dole zai sha saboda sunana.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:17
content: 17 Sa’an nan Ananiyas ya tafi gidan ya kuma shiga ciki. Da ya sa hannuwansa a kan Shawulu, sai ya ce, “Ɗan’uwana Shawulu, Ubangiji, Yesu, wanda ya bayyana gare ka a kan hanya yayinda kake zuwa nan, ya aiko ni domin ka sāke gani a kuma cika ka da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:18
content: 18 Nan da nan, sai wani abu kamar ɓawo ya fāɗo daga idanun Shawulu, ya kuma sāke iya ganin gari. Sai ya tashi aka kuma yi masa baftisma,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:19
content: 19 bayan ya ci abinci, sai sāke samun ƙarfi. Shawulu ya yi kwanaki masu yawa tare da almajiran da suke a Damaskus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:20
content: 20 Nan take ya fara wa’azi cikin majami’u cewa Yesu Ɗan Allah ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:21
content: 21 Dukan waɗanda suka ji shi suka yi mamaki suka ce, “Ba shi ne mutumin da ya tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a kan masu kira bisa ga wannan sunan a Urushalima ba? Ba ya zo nan ne don yă kai su a matsayin ’yan kurkuku ga manyan firistoci ba?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:22
content: 22 Duk da haka Shawulu ya yi ta ƙara ƙarfi, ya kuma rikitar da Yahudawan da suke zaune a Damaskus, ta wurin tabbatar musu cewa, Yesu shi ne Kiristi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:23
content: 23 Bayan kwanaki masu yawa, sai Yahudawa suka haɗa baki su kashe shi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:24
content: 24 amma Shawulu ya sami labarin shirinsu. Dare da rana suka yi fakonsa a ƙofofin birnin don su kashe shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:25
content: 25 Amma almajiransa suka ɗauke shi da dare suka saukar da shi a cikin kwando ta taga a katanga.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:26
content: 26 Da ya zo Urushalima, ya yi ƙoƙarin shiga cikin almajiran amma dukansu suka ji tsoronsa, ba su gaskata cewa tabbatacce shi almajiri ba ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:27
content: 27 Amma Barnabas ya ɗauke shi ya kawo shi wurin manzanni. Ya gaya musu yadda Shawulu a kan hanyarsa ya ga Ubangiji kuma cewa Ubangiji ya yi magana da shi, da yadda a Damaskus ya yi wa’azi ba tsoro a cikin sunan Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:28
content: 28 Saboda haka Shawulu ya zauna tare da su yana kai da kawowa a sake a cikin Urushalima, yana magana gabagadi a cikin sunan Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:29
content: 29 Ya yi magana ya kuma yi muhawwara da Yahudawa masu jin Hellenanci, amma suka yi ƙoƙarin kashe shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:30
content: 30 Sa’ad da ’yan’uwa suka sami labarin wannan, sai suka ɗauke shi zuwa Kaisariya suka aika da shi Tarshish.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:31
content: 31 Sa’an nan ikkilisiya ko’ina a Yahudiya, Galili da kuma Samariya ta sami salama. Ta yi ƙarfi; ta kuma ƙarfafa ta wurin Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ta ƙaru sosai tana rayuwa cikin tsoron Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:32
content: 32 Da Bitrus yake zazzaga ƙasar, sai ya je ya ziyarci tsarkakan da suke a Lidda.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:33
content: 33 A can ya tarar da wani mutum mai suna Eniyas, shanyayye wanda yake kwance kan gado shekara takwas.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:34
content: 34 Sai Bitrus ya ce masa, “Eniyas, Yesu Kiristi ya warkar da kai. Tashi ka naɗe tabarmarka.” Nan da nan Eniyas ya tashi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:35
content: 35 Duk waɗanda suke zama a Lidda da Sharon suka gan shi suka kuma juyo ga Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:36
content: 36 A Yoffa akwai wata almajira mai suna Tabita (a harshen Girik sunanta shi ne Dokas); ita mai aikin alheri ce kullum, tana kuma taimakon matalauta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:37
content: 37 A lokacin nan ta yi rashin lafiya ta mutu, aka kuma yi wa gawarta wanka aka ajiye a wani ɗaki a gidan sama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:38
content: 38 Lidda yana kusa da Yoffa; saboda haka sa’ad da almajirai suka ji cewa Bitrus yana a Lidda, sai suka aiki mutum biyu wurinsa su roƙe shi cewa, “In ka yarda ka zo nan da nan!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:39
content: 39 Sai Bitrus ya tafi tare da su, sa’ad da ya iso sai aka kai shi ɗakin saman. Duka gwauraye suka tsaya kewaye da shi, suna kuka suna nunnuna masa riguna da kuma waɗansu tufafin da Dokas ta yi yayinda take tare da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:40
content: 40 Bitrus ya fitar da su duka daga ɗakin; sa’an nan ya durƙusa ya yi addu’a. Da ya juya wajen matacciyar, sai ya ce, “Tabita, tashi.” Ta buɗe idanunta, ta ga Bitrus sai ta tashi zaune.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:41
content: 41 Ya kama ta a hannu ya taimake ta ta tsaya a ƙafafunta. Sa’an nan ya kira masu bi da kuma gwaurayen ya miƙa musu ita da rai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:42
content: 42 Wannan ya zama sananne ko’ina a Yoffa, mutane da yawa kuma suka gaskata da Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 9:43
content: 43 Bitrus ya zauna a Yoffa na ɗan lokaci tare da wani mai aikin fatu mai suna Siman.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:1
content: 1 A Kaisariya akwai wani mutum mai suna Korneliyus, wani jarumin Roma ne, a ƙungiyar soja da ake kira Bataliyar Italiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:2
content: 2 Shi da dukan iyalinsa masu ibada ne masu tsoron Allah kuma; yakan ba da kyauta hannu sake ga masu bukata yana kuma addu’a ga Allah ba fasawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:3
content: 3 Wata rana wajen ƙarfe uku na yamma ya ga wahayi. A sarari ya ga wani mala’ikan Allah, wanda ya zo wajensa ya ce, “Korneliyus!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:4
content: 4 Korneliyus kuwa ya zura masa ido a tsorace ya ce, “Mene ne, ya Ubangiji?” Mala’ikan ya ce, “Addu’o’inka da kyautanka ga matalauta sun kai har sama, hadayar tunawa ce a gaban Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:5
content: 5 Yanzu sai ka aiki mutane zuwa Yoffa su dawo da wani mutum mai suna Siman wanda ake kira Bitrus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:6
content: 6 Yana zama tare da Siman, mai aikin fatu, wanda gidansa ke bakin teku.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da mala’ikan da ya yi masa magana ya tafi, sai Korneliyus ya kira biyu daga cikin bayinsa da kuma wani soja mai ibada wanda yake ɗaya a cikin masu yin masa hidima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:8
content: 8 Ya fada musu duk abin da ya faru sa’an nan ya aike su Yoffa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:9
content: 9 Wajen tsakar rana kashegari yayinda suke cikin tafiyarsu suna kuma dab da birnin, sai Bitrus ya hau bisan rufin gida yă yi addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:10
content: 10 Yunwa ta kama shi ya kuwa so yă ci wani abu, yayinda ake shirya abinci, sai wahayi ya zo masa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:11
content: 11 Ya ga sama ya buɗe ana kuwa saukowa wani abu ƙasa kamar babban mayafi zuwa duniya ta kusurwansa huɗu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:12
content: 12 Cikinsa kuwa akwai kowace irin dabba mai ƙafa huɗu da masu ja da ciki na duniya da kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:13
content: 13 Sa’an nan wata murya ta ce masa, “Bitrus, ka tashi. Ka yanka ka ci.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:14
content: 14 Bitrus ya ce, “Sam, Ubangiji! Ban taɓa cin wani abu marar tsarki ko marar tsabta ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:15
content: 15 Muryar ta yi magana da shi sau na biyu ta ce, “Kada ka ce da abin da Allah ya tsarkake marar tsarki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:16
content: 16 Wannan ya faru har sau uku, sai nan da nan aka ɗauke mayafin zuwa sama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:17
content: 17 Tun Bitrus yana cikin tunani game da ma’anar wahayin nan, sai ga mutanen da Korneliyus ya aika sun sami gidan Siman suna kuma tsaye a ƙofar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:18
content: 18 Suka yi sallama, suna tambaya ko Siman wanda aka sani da suna Bitrus yana zama a can.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:19
content: 19 Yayinda Bitrus yana cikin tunani game da wahayin, sai Ruhu ya ce masa, “Siman, ga mutum uku suna nemanka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:20
content: 20 Saboda haka ka tashi ka sauka. Kada ka yi wata-wata, gama ni ne na aiko su.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:21
content: 21 Sai Bitrus ya sauka ya ce wa mutanen, “Ni ne kuke nema. Me ya kawo ku?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:22
content: 22 Mutanen suka amsa, “Mun zo ne daga wurin Korneliyus wani jarumin. Shi mutum ne mai adalci mai tsoron Allah kuma, wanda dukan Yahudawa ke girmamawa. Wani mala’ika mai tsarki ya faɗa masa, yă sa ka zo gidansa don yă ji abin da za ka faɗa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:23
content: 23 Sai Bitrus ya gayyaci mutanen cikin gida su zama baƙinsa. Kashegari Bitrus ya tafi tare da su, waɗansu ’yan’uwa daga Yoffa kuwa suka tafi tare da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:24
content: 24 Kashegari sai ya iso Kaisariya. Korneliyus kuwa yana nan yana jiransu, ya kuma gayyaci ’yan’uwansa da abokansa na kusa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:25
content: 25 Da Bitrus ya shiga gidan, Korneliyus ya sadu da shi ya kuma fāɗi a gabansa cikin bangirma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:26
content: 26 Amma Bitrus ya sa shi ya tashi. Ya ce, “Tashi, ni mutum ne kawai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:27
content: 27 Yana magana da shi, sai Bitrus ya shiga ciki ya kuma tarar da taron mutane da yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:28
content: 28 Sai ya ce musu, “Ku da kanku kun san cewa dokarmu ta hana mutumin Yahuda yin cuɗanya, ko ya ziyarci Ba’al’umme. Amma Allah ya nuna mini cewa kada in kira wani mutum marar tsarki ko marar tsabta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:29
content: 29 Don haka sa’ad da aka aika in zo, na zo ba wata faɗa. To, ko zan san abin da ya sa ka aika in zo?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:30
content: 30 Korneliyus ya amsa ya ce, “Kwana huɗu da suka wuce ina a gidana ina addu’a a wannan lokaci, wajen ƙarfe uku na yamma. Ba zato ba tsammani sai ga wani mutum cikin tufafi masu walƙiya ya tsaya a gabana

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:31
content: 31 ya ce, ‘Korneliyus, Allah ya ji addu’arka, ya kuma tuna da kyautanka ga matalauta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:32
content: 32 Ka aika zuwa Yoffa don a kira Siman wanda ake ce da shi Bitrus. Shi baƙo ne a gidan Siman mai aikin fatu, wanda yake zama a bakin teku.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:33
content: 33 Saboda haka na aika a zo da kai nan da nan, ya kuma yi kyau da ka zo. To ga mu duka a nan a gaban Allah don mu saurari dukan abin da Ubangiji ya umarce ka ka faɗa mana.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:34
content: 34 Sa’an nan Bitrus ya fara magana ya ce, “Yanzu na gane yadda gaskiya ne cewa Allah ba ya sonkai

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:35
content: 35 amma yana karɓan mutane daga kowace al’ummar da take tsoronsa suke kuma aikata abin da yake daidai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:36
content: 36 Kun san saƙon da Allah ya aika wa mutanen Isra’ila, yana shelar labari mai daɗi na salama ta wurin Yesu Kiristi, shi ne kuwa Ubangijin kowa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:37
content: 37 Kun san abin da ya faru a dukan Yahudiya, farawa daga Galili bayan baftismar da Yohanna ya yi wa’azi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:38
content: 38 yadda Allah ya shafe Yesu Banazare da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da kuma iko, da kuma yadda ya zaga ko’ina yana aikata alheri yana kuma warkar da dukan waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin ikon Iblis, domin Allah yana tare da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:39
content: 39 “Mu kuwa shaidu ne na dukan abin da ya yi a ƙasar Yahudawa da kuma a Urushalima. Suka kashe shi ta wurin rataye shi a kan itace,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:40
content: 40 amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu a rana ta uku, ya sa kuma aka gan shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:41
content: 41 Ba dukan mutane ne suka gan shi ba, amma ta wurin shaidun da Allah ya riga ya zaɓa, ta wurinmu da muka ci muka kuma sha tare da shi bayan tashinsa daga matattu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:42
content: 42 Ya umarce mu mu yi wa’azi ga mutane mu kuma shaida cewa shi ne wanda Allah ya naɗa yă zama mai shari’a na masu rai da na matattu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:43
content: 43 Duk annabawa sun yi shaida game da shi cewa duk wanda ya ba da gaskiya gare shi zai sami gafarar zunubai ta wurin sunansa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:44
content: 44 Tun Bitrus yana cikin faɗin waɗannan kalmomi, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka wa duk waɗanda suka ji saƙon.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:45
content: 45 Masu bin da suke da kaciya waɗanda suka zo tare da Bitrus suka yi mamaki cewa an ba da kyautar Ruhu Mai Tsarki har ma a kan Al’ummai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:46
content: 46 Gama sun ji su suna magana da waɗansu harsuna suna kuma yabon Allah. Sai Bitrus ya ce,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:47
content: 47 “Wani zai iya hana a yi wa waɗannan mutane baftisma da ruwa? Sun karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki kamar yadda muka karɓa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 10:48
content: 48 Saboda haka ya ba da umarni a yi musu baftisma cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi. Sa’an nan suka roƙi Bitrus yă zauna da su na ’yan kwanaki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:1
content: 1 Manzanni da ’yan’uwa ko’ina a Yahudiya suka ji cewa Al’ummai ma sun karɓi maganar Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:2
content: 2 Saboda haka sa’ad da Bitrus ya haura zuwa Urushalima, masu bin da suke da kaciya suka zarge shi

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:3
content: 3 suka ce, “Ka je gidan mutanen da suke marasa kaciya ka kuwa ci tare da su.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:4
content: 4 Bitrus ya fara yin musu bayani dalla-dalla yadda ya faru cewa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:5
content: 5 “Ina a birnin Yoffa ina addu’a, sai ga wahayi ya zo mini. Na ga ana sauko da wani abu kamar babban mayafi daga sama ta kusurwansa huɗu, ya kuma sauko inda nake.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:6
content: 6 Na duba cikinsa na ga dabbobi masu ƙafa huɗu na duniya, da namun jeji, da masu ja da ciki, da kuma tsuntsayen sararin sama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:7
content: 7 Sa’an nan na ji wata murya tana ce mini, ‘Bitrus, ka tashi. Ka yanka ka ci.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:8
content: 8 “Na amsa na ce, ‘Sam, Ubangiji! Ban taɓa cin wani abu marar tsarki ko marar tsabta ba.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:9
content: 9 “Sai muryar daga sama ta yi magana sau na biyu, ta ce, ‘Kada ka ce da abin da Allah ya tsarkake marar tsarki.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:10
content: 10 Wannan ya faru har sau uku, sa’an nan duk aka sāke ɗauke shi zuwa sama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:11
content: 11 “Nan take sai ga mutum uku da aka aika wurina daga Kaisariya a tsaye a ƙofar gidan da nake.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:12
content: 12 Ruhu ya ce mini kada in yi wata-wata game da tafiya tare da su. Waɗannan ’yan’uwa guda shida su ma suka rako ni, muka kuwa shiga gidan mutumin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:13
content: 13 Ya kuma gaya mana yadda wani mala’ika ya bayyana a gidansa ya ce masa, ‘Ka aika zuwa Yoffa a kira Siman wanda ake ce da shi Bitrus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:14
content: 14 Zai kawo maka saƙo wanda ta wurinsa kai da dukan iyalinka za ku sami ceto.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:15
content: 15 “Na fara magana ke nan, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauko musu yadda ya sauko mana a farko.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:16
content: 16 Sa’an nan na tuna da abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Yohanna ya yi baftisma da ruwa, amma za a yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:17
content: 17 To, in Allah ya ba su kyauta yadda ya ba mu, mu da muka gaskata da Ubangiji Yesu Kiristi, wane ni da zan yi hamayya da Allah?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:18
content: 18 Sa’ad da suka ji haka, ba su ƙara yin faɗa ba, suka kuma ɗaukaka Allah, suna cewa, “To, fa, har Al’ummai ma Allah ya sa suka tuba zuwa rai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:19
content: 19 To, waɗanda suka warwatsu saboda tsananin da ya tashi a kan batun Istifanus suka tafi har Funisiya, Saifurus da kuma Antiyok, suna ba da saƙon ga Yahudawa kaɗai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:20
content: 20 Amma waɗansunsu kuwa, mutane daga Saifurus da Sairin, suka je Antiyok suka fara yi wa Hellenawa magana su ma, suna ba da labari mai daɗi game da Ubangiji Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:21
content: 21 Hannun Ubangiji kuwa yana tare da su, mutane da yawan gaske kuwa suka gaskata suka juya ga Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:22
content: 22 Labari wannan abu ya kai kunnuwan ikkilisiya a Urushalima, sai suka aiki Barnabas zuwa Antiyok.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:23
content: 23 Da ya iso ya kuma ga tabbacin alherin Allah, sai ya yi farin ciki ya kuma ƙarfafa su duka su tsaya da gaskiya cikin Ubangiji da dukan zukatansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:24
content: 24 Mutum ne nagari, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki da bangaskiya, mutane masu yawan gaske kuwa suka juya ga Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:25
content: 25 Sa’an nan Barnabas ya tafi Tarshish don yă nemi Shawulu,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:26
content: 26 sa’ad da ya same shi kuwa, sai ya kawo shi Antiyok. Ta haka shekara guda cur Barnabas da Shawulu suka yi suna taruwa da ikkilisiya, suka kuma koya wa mutane masu yawan gaske. A Antiyok ne aka fara kiran almajirai da suna Kirista.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:27
content: 27 A wannan lokaci waɗansu annabawa sun zo Antiyok daga Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:28
content: 28 Ɗaya daga cikinsu mai suna Agabus, ya miƙe tsaye ya yi annabci ta wurin Ruhu cewa za a yi yunwa mai tsanani wadda za tă bazu a dukan duniyar Romawa (Wannan ya faru a zamanin mulkin Kalaudiyus.)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:29
content: 29 Kowanne a cikin almajiran, gwargwadon azancinsa, ya yanke shawara ya ba da gudummawa ga ’yan’uwan da suke zama a Yahudiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 11:30
content: 30 Haka kuwa suka yi, suka aika da kyautarsa wa dattawan ikkilisiyar ta hannu Barnabas da Shawulu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:1
content: 1 Kusan a wannan lokaci ne Sarki Hiridus ya kama waɗansu da suke na ikkilisiya, da niyya ya tsananta musu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:2
content: 2 Ya sa aka kashe Yaƙub, ɗan’uwan Yohanna, da takobi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:3
content: 3 Sa’ad da ya ga wannan ya faranta wa Yahudawa rai, sai ya kama Bitrus shi ma. Wannan ya faru kwanakin Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:4
content: 4 Bayan ya kama shi, sai ya sa shi a kurkuku, ya danƙa shi a hannun soja hurhuɗu kashi huɗu, don su yi gadinsa. Hiridus ya yi niyyar ya yi masa shari’a a gaban mutane bayan Bikin Ƙetarewa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:5
content: 5 Saboda haka aka tsare Bitrus a kurkuku, amma ikkilisiya ta nace da addu’a ga Allah dominsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:6
content: 6 A daren da in gari ya waye da Hiridus yake niyyar kawo shi domin a yi masa shari’a, Bitrus yana barci tsakanin sojoji biyu, daure da sarƙoƙi biyu, masu gadi kuma suna bakin ƙofa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:7
content: 7 Ba zato ba tsammani sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana haske kuma ya haskaka a ɗakin. Ya bugi Bitrus a gefe ya kuma tashe shi ya ce, “Maza, ka tashi!” Sarƙoƙin kuwa suka zube daga hannuwansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:8
content: 8 Sa’an nan mala’ikan ya ce masa, “Ka sa rigunarka da takalmanka.” Bitrus kuwa ya sa. Mala’ikan ya faɗa masa cewa, “Ka yafa mayafinka ka bi ni.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:9
content: 9 Bitrus ya bi shi suka fita kurkukun, amma bai ma san cewa abin da mala’ikan yake yi tabbatacce ne ba; yana tsammani wahayi yake gani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:10
content: 10 Suka wuce masu gadi na fari da na biyu, suka kuma isa ƙofar ƙarfe ta shiga birni. Ƙofar kuwa ta buɗe musu da kanta, suka kuma wuce. Sa’ad da suka yi tafiya tsawon wani titi, nan take mala’ikan ya bar shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:11
content: 11 Sai Bitrus ya dawo hankalinsa ya ce, “Yanzu na sani ba shakka Ubangiji ne ya aiki mala’ikansa yă cece ni daga hannun Hiridus da kuma dukan mugun fatan Yahudawa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:12
content: 12 Da ya gane haka, sai ya tafi gidan Maryamu uwar Yohanna, wanda ake kuma kira Markus, inda mutane da yawa suka taru suna addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:13
content: 13 Bitrus ya ƙwanƙwasa ƙofar waje, sai wata mai aiki a gidan da ake kira Roda ta zo tă ji ko wane ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:14
content: 14 Da ta gane muryar Bitrus, ta cika da murna ta gudu ta koma ba tare da ta buɗe ƙofar ba, sai ta koma a guje ta ce da ƙarfi, “Ga Bitrus a bakin ƙofa!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:15
content: 15 Sai suka ce mata, “Kina hauka.” Da ta nace cewa shi ne, sai suka ce, “To, lalle, mala’ikansa ne.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:16
content: 16 Amma Bitrus ya yi ta ƙwanƙwasawa. Da suka buɗe ƙofar suka kuma gan shi, sai suka yi mamaki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:17
content: 17 Bitrus ya yi musu alama da hannunsa su yi shiru sai ya bayyana yadda Ubangiji ya fitar da shi daga kurkuku. Ya ce, “Ku gaya wa Yaƙub da kuma ’yan’uwa game da wannan,” sa’an nan ya tashi ya tafi wani wuri.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:18
content: 18 Da safe, hargitsin da ya tashi tsakanin sojojin ba ƙarami ba ne, a kan abin da ya sami Bitrus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:19
content: 19 Bayan Hiridus ya neme shi bai same shi ba, sai ya tuhumi masu gadin, ya kuma ba da umarni a kashe su. Sa’an nan Hiridus ya tashi daga Yahudiya ya tafi Kaisariya ya kuma yi ’yan kwanaki a can.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:20
content: 20 Yana da rashin jituwa da mutanen Taya da na Sidon; sai suka haɗa kai suka nemi ganawa da shi. Bayan suka sami goyon bayan Bilastus, amintaccen bawan sarki, sai suka nemi salama, domin sun dogara ga ƙasar sarkin don samun abincinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:21
content: 21 A ranar da aka shirya Hiridus, sanye da kayan sarautarsa, ya zauna a gadon sarautarsa ya kuma ya wa mutanen jawabi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:22
content: 22 Suka tā da murya suka ce, “Wannan muryar wani allah ne, ba ta mutum ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:23
content: 23 Nan take, domin Hiridus bai yi wa Allah yabo ba, wani mala’ikan Ubangiji ya buge shi, tsutsotsi kuwa suka cinye shi ya kuma mutu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:24
content: 24 Amma maganar Allah ta ci gaba da ƙaruwa ta kuma bazu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 12:25
content: 25 Sa’ad da Barnabas da Shawulu suka kammala aikinsu, sai suka komo daga Urushalima, tare da Yohanna, wanda ake kira Markus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:1
content: 1 A ikkilisiyar da take a Antiyok akwai waɗansu annabawa da malamai. Barnabas, Siman wanda ake kira Baƙi, Lusiyus mutumin Sairin, Manayen (wanda aka goya tare da Hiridus mai mulki), da kuma Shawulu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:2
content: 2 Yayinda suna cikin sujada da azumi ga Ubangiji, Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, “Ku keɓe mini Barnabas da Shawulu domin aikin da na kira su.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:3
content: 3 Saboda haka bayan suka yi azumi da addu’a, sai suka ɗibiya musu hannuwansu a kansu suka sallame su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:4
content: 4 Sai su biyu da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya aika suka gangara zuwa Selusiya suka shiga jirgin ruwa daga can zuwa Saifurus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:5
content: 5 Da suka isa Salamis, sai suka yi shelar maganar Allah a majami’un Yahudawa. Yohanna yana tare da su a matsayin mai taimakonsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:6
content: 6 Suka zaga dukan tsibirin har sai da suka kai Bafos. A can suka sadu da wani mutumin Yahuda mai sihiri, annabin ƙarya, mai suna Bar-Yesu,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:7
content: 7 wanda yake ma’aikacin muƙaddas Sergiyus Bulus ne. Muƙaddas ɗin kuwa mai azanci ne ƙwarai, ya sa aka kira Barnabas da Shawulu don yana so ya ji maganar Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:8
content: 8 Amma Elimas mai sihirin nan (domin ma’anar sunansa ke nan) ya yi hamayya da maganarsu ya kuma yi ƙoƙari ya juyar da muƙaddas ɗin daga bangaskiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:9
content: 9 Sai Shawulu, wanda kuma ake kira Bulus, cike da Ruhu Mai Tsarki, ya kafa wa Elimas ido ya ce,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:10
content: 10 “Kai ɗan Iblis ne abokin gāban dukan abin da yake daidai! Kana cike da kowane irin ruɗi da munafunci. Ba za ka daina karkata hanyoyin da suke daidai na Ubangiji ba?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:11
content: 11 Ga shi hannun Ubangiji yana gāba da kai. Za ka makance, kuma ba za ka ga rana ba har na wani lokaci.” Nan take, hazo da duhu suka sauko a kansa, ya yi ta lallubawa, yana neman wanda zai yi masa jagora.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da muƙaddas ɗin ya ga abin da ya faru, sai ya ba da gaskiya, gama ya yi mamaki a kan da koyarwa game Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:13
content: 13 Bulus da abokan tafiyarsa suka tashi daga Bafos a jirgin ruwa zuwa Ferga a Famfiliya inda Yohanna ya bar su ya koma Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:14
content: 14 Daga Ferga kuwa suka ci gaba zuwa Antiyok na Fisidiya. A ranar Asabbaci sai suka shiga majami’a suka zauna.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:15
content: 15 Bayan an yi karatu daga cikin Doka, da kuma Annabawa, sai shugabannin majami’ar suka aika musu suka ce, “’Yan’uwa, in kuna da wani saƙon ƙarfafawa domin jama’a, sai ku yi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:16
content: 16 Yana miƙewa tsaye, sai Bulus ya yi musu alama da hannu ya ce, “Mutanen Isra’ila da kuma ku Al’ummai da kuke wa Allah sujada, ku saurare ni!

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:17
content: 17 Allahn mutanen Isra’ila ya zaɓi kakanninmu; ya kuma sa mutanen suka yi bunkasa yayinda suke zama a ƙasar Masar, da iko mai girma ya fitar da su daga ƙasar,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:18
content: 18 ya kuma jure da halinsu har shekara arba’in a cikin hamada,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:19
content: 19 ya tumɓuke ƙasashe bakwai a Kan’ana ya kuma ba da ƙasarsu gādo ga mutanensa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:20
content: 20 Dukan wannan ya ɗauki kusan shekaru 450. “Bayan wannan, Allah ya ba su alƙalai har zuwa zamanin annabi Sama’ila.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:21
content: 21 Sa’an nan mutanen suka nemi a ba su sarki, Allah kuwa ya ba su Shawulu ɗan Kish, na kabilar Benyamin, wanda ya yi mulki shekaru arba’in.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:22
content: 22 Bayan an kau da Shawulu, sai ya naɗa Dawuda ya zama sarkinsu. Ya kuma yi shaida game da shi cewa, ‘Na sami Dawuda ɗan Yesse, mutum ne da nake so a zuciyata; shi zai aikata dukan abin da nake so.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:23
content: 23 “Daga zuriyar mutumin nan ne Allah ya kawo wa Isra’ila Mai Ceto Yesu, kamar yadda ya yi alkawari.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:24
content: 24 Kafin zuwan Yesu, Yohanna ya yi wa’azin tuba da baftisma ga dukan mutanen Isra’ila.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:25
content: 25 Yayinda Yohanna yake kammala aikinsa ya ce, ‘Wa kuke tsammani ni nake? Ba ni ne shi ba. A’a, amma yana zuwa bayana, wanda ko takalmansa ma ban isa in kunce ba.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:26
content: 26 “Ya ku ’yan’uwa, ’ya’yan Ibrahim, da ku kuma Al’ummai masu tsoron Allah, a gare mu ne fa aka aiko wannan saƙon ceto.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:27
content: 27 Mutanen Urushalima da masu mulkinsu ba su gane da Yesu ba, duk da haka cikin hukunta shi suka cika kalmomin annabawan da ake karantawa kowane Asabbaci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:28
content: 28 Ko da yake ba su same shi da wani dalilin da ya kai ga hukuncin kisa ba, suka roƙi Bilatus yă sa a kashe shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:29
content: 29 Sa’ad da suka aikata duk abin da aka rubuta game da shi, sai suka saukar da shi daga itacen suka kuma sa shi a kabari.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:30
content: 30 Amma Allah ya tashe shi daga matattu,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:31
content: 31 kuma kwanaki da yawa waɗanda suka yi tafiya tare da shi daga Galili zuwa Urushalima suka gan shi. Su ne yanzu shaidu ga mutanenmu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:32
content: 32 “Muna gaya muku labari mai daɗi cewa abin da Allah ya yi wa kakanninmu alkawari,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:33
content: 33 ya cika mana, mu zuriyarsu, ta wurin tā da Yesu daga matattu. Kamar yadda yake a rubuce a cikin Zabura ta biyu cewa, “ ‘Kai Ɗana ne, yau na zama Uba a gare ka.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:34
content: 34 Gaskiyar cewa Allah ya tā da shi daga matattu, a kan ba zai taɓa ruɓewa ba, an faɗe shi a cikin waɗannan kalmomi. “ ‘Zan ba ku tsarki da kuma tabbatattun albarkun da na yi wa Dawuda alkawari.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:35
content: 35 Haka kuma aka faɗa a wani wuri. “ ‘Ba za ka yarda Mai Tsarkinka ya ruɓa ba.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:36
content: 36 “Gama sa’ad da Dawuda ya gama hidimar nufin Allah a zamaninsa, sai ya yi barci; aka binne shi tare da kakanninsa jikinsa kuwa ya ruɓe.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:37
content: 37 Amma wanda Allah ya tā da daga matattu bai ruɓa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:38
content: 38 “Saboda haka, ’yan’uwana, ina so ku san cewa ta wurin Yesu ana sanar muku da gafarar zunubi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:39
content: 39 Ta wurinsa kowa da ya gaskata an kuɓutar da shi daga dukan abin da Dokar Musa ba tă iya kuɓutar ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:40
content: 40 Ku lura kada abubuwan da annabawa suka faɗa su faru muku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:41
content: 41 “ ‘Ku duba, ku masu ba’a, ku yi mamaki, ku hallaka, gama zan yi wani abu a zamaninku da ba za ku taɓa gaskatawa ba ko da wani ya gaya muku.’”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:42
content: 42 Bulus da Barnabas suna fita daga majami’ar ke nan, sai mutane suka gayyace su su ƙara yin maganan nan a kan waɗannan abubuwa a ranar Asabbaci mai zuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:43
content: 43 Da aka sallami jama’a, Yahudawa da yawa da kuma waɗanda suka tuba suka shiga Yahudanci masu ibada suka bi Bulus da Barnabas, waɗanda suka yi magana musu suka kuma ƙarfafa su su ci gaba a cikin alherin Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:44
content: 44 A ranar Asabbaci na biye kusan dukan birnin suka taru don su ji maganar Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:45
content: 45 Sa’ad da Yahudawa suka ga taron mutanen, sai suka cika da kishi suka yi ta munanan maganganu a kan abin da Bulus yake faɗi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:46
content: 46 Sai Bulus da Barnabas suka amsa musu gabagadi, suka ce, “Ya zama mana dole mu yi muku maganar Allah da farko. Da yake kun ƙi ta ba ku kuma ga kun cancanci rai madawwami ba, to, za mu juya ga Al’ummai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:47
content: 47 Gama abin da Allah ya umarce mu ke nan cewa, “ ‘Na sa ka zama haske ga Al’ummai, don ka kawo cetona zuwa iyakokin duniya.’”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:48
