content: 48 Sa’ad da Al’ummai suka ji haka, sai suka yi farin ciki suka ɗaukaka maganar Ubangiji; kuma duk waɗanda aka zaɓa don samun rai madawwami, suka gaskata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:49
content: 49 Maganar Ubangiji kuwa ta bazu a dukan yankin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:50
content: 50 Amma Yahudawa suka zuga waɗansu mata masu tsoron Allah masu martaba da kuma waɗansu maza masu matsayi a gari. Suka tā da tsanani ga Bulus da Barnabas, suka kore su daga yankinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:51
content: 51 Saboda haka suka karkaɗe ƙurar ƙafafunsu don shaidar a kansu suka kuwa tafi Ikoniyum.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 13:52
content: 52 Masu bi kuwa suka cika da farin ciki da kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:1
content: 1 A Ikoniyum Bulus da Barnabas suka shiga majami’ar Yahudawa yadda suka saba. A can suka yi magana gabagadi har Yahudawa da Al’ummai masu yawa suka gaskata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:2
content: 2 Amma Yahudawan da suka ƙi ba da gaskata, suka zuga Al’ummai suka sa ɓata tsakaninsu da ’yan’uwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:3
content: 3 Bulus da Barnabas kuwa suka daɗe sosai a can, suna magana gabagadi saboda Ubangiji, wanda kuwa ya tabbatar da saƙon alherinsa ta wurinsa su su aikata ayyuka da alamu masu banmamaki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:4
content: 4 Mutanen birnin suka rarrabu, waɗansu suka goyi bayan Yahudawa, waɗansu kuma suka goyi bayan manzannin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:5
content: 5 Yahudawa da Al’ummai tare da shugabanninsu suka ƙulla shawara a tsakaninsu, domin su wulaƙanta su su kuma jajjefe su da duwatsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:6
content: 6 Amma suka sami labari suka kuma gudu zuwa biranen Ikoniyum na Listira da Derbe da kuma ƙauyukan kewaye,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:7
content: 7 inda suka ci gaba da wa’azin labari mai daɗi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:8
content: 8 A Listira kuwa akwai wani gurgu zaune a ƙafafunsa, wanda gurgu ne tun haihuwa, kuma bai taɓa tafiya ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:9
content: 9 Ya kasa kunne yayinda Bulus yake magana. Bulus kuma ya kafa masa ido, ya lura cewa yana da bangaskiyar da za tă warkar da shi

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:10
content: 10 sai ya ɗaga murya ya ce, “Tashi ka tsaya kan ƙafafunka!” Da jin haka, sai mutumin ya yi wuf ya kuma fara tafiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:11
content: 11 Sa’ad da taron suka ga abin da Bulus ya yi, sai suka ihu da harshen Likayoniyawa, suna cewa, “Alloli sun sauka mana da siffar mutane!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:12
content: 12 Sai suka ba wa Barnabas, sunan Zeyus, Bulus kuma suka kira Hermes domin shi ne shugaban magana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:13
content: 13 Firist na Zeyus, wanda haikalinsa ke bayan birni, ya kawo bijimai da furanni a ƙofofin birni domin shi da taron mutanen sun so su miƙa musu hadayu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:14
content: 14 Amma da manzannin nan Barnabas da Bulus suka ji haka, sai suka yayyage tufafinsu suka ruga cikin taron, suna ihu suna cewa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:15
content: 15 “Ya ku mutane, don me kuke yin haka? Ai, mu ma mutane ne kawai, ’yan adam ne kamar ku. Mun kawo muku labari mai daɗi ne, muna gaya muku ku juya daga waɗannan abubuwa banza, ku juyo ga Allah mai rai, wanda ya yi sama da ƙasa da teku da kuma dukan abin da yake cikinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:16
content: 16 A zamanin dā, ya bar dukan ƙasashe su yi yadda suka ga dama.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:17
content: 17 Duk da haka bai bar kansa babu shaida ba. Ya nuna alheri ta wurin ba ku ruwan sama da kuma amfanin gona a lokutansu; ya ba ku abinci mai yawa ya kuma cika zukatanku da farin ciki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:18
content: 18 Ko da waɗannan kalmomi ma, da ƙyar suka hana jama’an nan yin musu hadaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:19
content: 19 Sai waɗansu Yahudawa suka zo daga Antiyok da Ikoniyum suka sha kan taron. Suka jajjefi Bulus da duwatsu suka kuma ja shi bayan birni, suna tsammani ya mutu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:20
content: 20 Amma bayan da almajiran suka taru kewaye da shi, sai ya tashi ya koma cikin birni. Kashegari shi da Barnabas suka tashi zuwa Derbe.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:21
content: 21 Suka yi wa’azin Labari mai daɗi a wannan birni, suka kuma sami almajirai da yawa. Sai suka koma Listira, Ikoniyum da kuma Antiyok,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:22
content: 22 suna gina almajirai suna kuma ƙarfafa su su tsaya da gaske cikin bangaskiya. Suka ce, “Sai da shan wahaloli masu yawa za mu shiga mulkin Allah.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:23
content: 23 Bulus da Barnabas suka naɗa musu dattawa a kowace ikkilisiya, tare da addu’a da azumi, suka miƙa su ga Ubangiji, wanda suka dogara da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:24
content: 24 Bayan sun bi ta Fisidiya, sai suka zo cikin Famfiliya,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:25
content: 25 kuma sa’ad da suka yi wa’azi a Ferga, sai suka gangara zuwa Attaliya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:26
content: 26 Daga Attaliya kuma suka shiga jirgin ruwa suka koma Antiyok, inda dā aka danƙa su ga alherin Allah saboda aikin da suka kammala yanzu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:27
content: 27 Da isarsu a can, sai suka tara ikkilisiya wuri ɗaya suka ba da rahoton duk abin da Allah ya aikata ta wurinsu da kuma yadda ya buɗe ƙofar bangaskiya domin Al’ummai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 14:28
content: 28 Suka kuma jima a can tare da almajirai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:1
content: 1 Waɗansu mutane suka gangara daga Yahudiya zuwa Antiyok suna kuma koya wa ’yan’uwa cewa, “Sai ko an yi muku kaciya bisa ga al’ada da Musa ya koyar, in ba haka ba, ba za ku sami ceto ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:2
content: 2 Wannan ya kai Bulus da Barnabas suka shiga babban gardama da muhawwara da su. Saboda haka aka naɗa Bulus da Barnabas tare da waɗansu masu bi, su haura zuwa Urushalima don su ga manzanni da dattawa a kan wannan magana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:3
content: 3 Ikkilisiya ta raka su suka tafi, yayinda suke ratsawa ta Funisiya da Samariya, suka ba da labari yadda Al’ummai suka tuba. Wannan labarin ya sa dukan ’yan’uwa suka yi murna ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:4
content: 4 Sa’ad da suka isa Urushalima, sai ikkilisiya da manzanni da kuma dattawa suka marabce su, sai suka ba su rahoton dukan abin da Allah ya aikata ta wurinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:5
content: 5 Sai waɗansu daga cikin masu bin da suke na ƙungiyar Farisiyawa suka miƙe tsaye suka ce, “Dole ne a yi wa Al’ummai kaciya a kuma bukace su su yi biyayya da dokokin Musa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:6
content: 6 Sai manzanni da dattawa suka taru don su duba maganar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:7
content: 7 Bayan aka yi muhawwara da sosai, sai Bitrus ya miƙe tsaye ya yi musu jawabi ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, kun san cewa a kwanakin baya Allah ya yi zaɓe a cikinku don Al’ummai su ji daga leɓunana saƙon bishara su kuma gaskata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:8
content: 8 Allah, wanda ya san zuciya, ya nuna cewa ya karɓe su ta wurin ba su Ruhu Mai Tsarki, kamar yadda ya ba mu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:9
content: 9 Bai nuna bambanci tsakaninmu da su ba, gama ya tsarkake zukatansu ta wurin bangaskiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:10
content: 10 To, fa, don me kuke ƙoƙari ku gwada Allah ta wurin ɗora wa almajiran nan kayan da mu ko kakanninmu ba mu iya ɗauka ba?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:11
content: 11 A’a! Mun gaskata cewa ta wurin alherin Ubangiji Yesu ne muka sami ceto, kamar yadda su ma suka samu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:12
content: 12 Sai duk taron suka yi tsit yayinda suke sauraron Barnabas da Bulus suna ba da labari game da ayyuka da kuma abubuwan banmamakin da Allah ya yi a cikin Al’ummai ta wurinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:13
content: 13 Da suka gama, sai Yaƙub ya yi magana ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, ku saurare ni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:14
content: 14 Siman ya bayyana mana yadda Allah da farko ya nuna damuwarsa ta wurin ɗaukan mutane daga cikin Al’ummai su zama nasa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:15
content: 15 Kalmomin annabawa sun yi daidai da wannan, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:16
content: 16 “ ‘Bayan wannan zan koma in kuma sāke gina tentin Dawuda da ya rushe. Kufansa zan sāke gina, in kuma mai da shi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:17
content: 17 don ragowar mutane su nemi Ubangiji, kuma duk Al’umman da suke kira bisa sunana, in ji Ubangiji, wanda yake yin waɗannan abubuwa’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:18
content: 18 da aka sani tun zamanai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:19
content: 19 “Saboda haka, a ganina, kada mu matsa wa Al’ummai waɗanda suke juyowa ga Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:20
content: 20 A maimakon haka, ya kamata mu rubuta musu cewa, su guji abincin da alloli suka ƙazantar, da fasikanci, da naman dabbar da aka murɗe da kuma jini.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:21
content: 21 Gama Musa ya yi wa’azi a kowace birni tun zamanin dā, ana kuma karanta shi a majami’u kowane Asabbaci.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:22
content: 22 Sai manzanni da dattawa, tare da dukan ikkilisiya, suka yanke shawara su zaɓi waɗansu daga cikin mutanensu su kuma aike su zuwa Antiyok tare da Bulus da Barnabas. Sai suka zaɓi Yahuda (wanda ake kira Barsabbas) da kuma Sila, mutum biyu da suke shugabanni cikin ’yan’uwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:23
content: 23 Tare da su suka aika da wannan wasiƙa. Daga manzanni da dattawa, ’yan’uwanku. Zuwa ga Al’ummai masu bi a Antiyok, Suriya da Silisiya. Gaisuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:24
content: 24 Mun ji cewa, waɗansu da sun fita daga cikinmu ba tare da izininmu ba suka kuma dame ku, suna tā da hankalinku ta wurin abin da suka ce.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:25
content: 25 Saboda haka dukanmu mun yarda mu zaɓi waɗansu mutane mu kuma aike su wurinku tare da ƙaunatattun abokanmu Barnabas da Bulus

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:26
content: 26 mutanen da suka sa rayukansu cikin hatsari saboda sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:27
content: 27 Saboda haka muna aika Yahuda da Sila don su tabbatar muku da baki abin da muka rubuta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:28
content: 28 Ya gamshe Ruhu Mai Tsarki da mu ma kada a ɗora muku nauyi fiye da na waɗannan abubuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:29
content: 29 Ku guji abincin da aka yi wa alloli hadaya, da jini, da naman dabbar da aka murɗe da kuma fasikanci. Za ku kyauta in kun kiyaye waɗannan abubuwa. Ku huta lafiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:30
content: 30 Aka sallami mutanen sai suka gangara zuwa Antiyok, inda suka tara ikkilisiya wuri ɗaya suka ba da wasiƙar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:31
content: 31 Mutanen suka karantata suka kuma yi farin ciki saboda saƙonta mai ƙarfafawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:32
content: 32 Yahuda da Sila, waɗanda su kansu annabawa ne, suka yi magana sosai don su gina su kuma ƙarfafa ’yan’uwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:33
content: 33 Bayan suka yi ’yan kwanaki a can, sai ’yan’uwa suka sallame su da albarkar salama su dawo wurin waɗanda suka aike su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:35
content: 35 Amma Bulus da Barnabas kuwa suka dakata a Antiyok, inda su da waɗansu da yawa suka yi koyarwa suka kuma yi wa’azin maganar Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:36
content: 36 Bayan ’yan kwanaki sai Bulus ya ce wa Barnabas, “Mu koma mu ziyarci ’yan’uwa a duk garuruwan da muka yi wa’azin bisharar Ubangiji mu ga yadda suke.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:37
content: 37 Barnabas ya so Yohanna, wanda ake kira Markus ya tafi tare da su,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:38
content: 38 amma Bulus bai ga ya kyautu ya tafi da shi ba, domin ya yashe su a Famfiliya bai kuwa ci gaba tare da su a aikin ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:39
content: 39 Suka sami saɓanin ra’ayi tsakaninsu har suka rabu. Barnabas ya ɗauki Markus suka shiga jirgin ruwa zuwa Saifurus,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:40
content: 40 amma Bulus ya zaɓi Sila suka kuwa tashi, bayan ’yan’uwa suka danƙa su ga alherin Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 15:41
content: 41 Ya ratsa ta Suriya da Silisiya, yana ƙarfafa ikkilisiyoyi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:1
content: 1 Bulus ya kai Derbe sa’an nan kuma zuwa Listira, inda wani almajiri mai suna Timoti yake da zama, wanda mahaifiyarsa mutuniyar Yahuda ce kuma mai bi ce, amma mahaifinsa mutumin Hellenawa ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:2
content: 2 ’Yan’uwa a Listira da Ikoniyum sun yi magana mai kyau ƙwarai a kansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:3
content: 3 Bulus ya so ya ɗauke shi a tafiyar, saboda haka ya yi masa kaciya, domin Yahudawan da suke da zama a wurin, don duk sun san cewa mahaifinsa mutumin Hellenawa ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:4
content: 4 Yayinda suke tafiya daga gari zuwa gari, suka dinga ba da shawarwarin da manzanni da dattawa a Urushalima suka zartar domin mutane su kiyaye.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:5
content: 5 Saboda haka ikkilisiyoyi suka ginu cikin bangaskiya suka kuma yi girma suka yi ta ƙaruwa kowace rana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:6
content: 6 Bulus da abokan tafiyarsa suka zazzaga dukan yankin Firjiya da Galatiya, don Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya hana su yin wa’azi a lardin Asiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:7
content: 7 Da suka isa kan iyakar Misiya, suka yi ƙoƙari su shiga Bitiniya, amma Ruhun Yesu bai yarda musu ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:8
content: 8 Saboda haka suka ratsa Misiya suka zo Toruwas.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:9
content: 9 Da dare Bulus ya ga wahayin wani mutumin Makidoniya yana tsaye yana roƙonsa cewa, “Ka zo Makidoniya ka taimake mu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:10
content: 10 Bayan Bulus ya ga wahayin, muka shirya nan take mu tashi zuwa Makidoniya, mun tabbata cewa, Allah ya kira mu mu yi musu wa’azin bishara.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:11
content: 11 Daga Toruwas muka tashi zuwa teku muka kuma shiga jirgin ruwa muka miƙe kai tsaye zuwa Samotiras, kashegari kuma muka nufi Neyafolis.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:12
content: 12 Daga can muka tafi Filibbi, wata babbar alkaryar Roma wadda kuma take babban birni a gundumar Makidoniya. Muka zauna a can kwanaki masu yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:13
content: 13 A Asabbaci, muka fita ƙofar birnin zuwa bakin kogi, inda muke tsammani za mu sami wurin yin addu’a. Muka zauna muka fara yin wa matan da suka taru a can magana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:14
content: 14 Ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda suka saurare mu mace ce mai suna Lidiya, mai sayar da yadunan jan garura masu tsada daga birnin Tiyatira, mai yi wa Allah sujada. Ubangiji ya buɗe zuciyarta har ta karɓi saƙon Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:15
content: 15 Da aka yi mata baftisma tare da iyalin gidanta, sai ta gayyace mu zuwa gidanta. Ta ce, “In kun amince ni mai bi ce cikin Ubangiji, sai ku zo ku sauka a gidana.” Sai ta kuwa rinjaye mu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:16
content: 16 Wata rana muna tafiya zuwa wurin yin addu’a, sai muka sadu da wata baranya mai ruhun aljani mai duba. Takan samo wa mutanenta kuɗi da yawa, duban da take yi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:17
content: 17 Wannan yarinya kuwa ta bi Bulus da kuma sauranmu, tana ihu tana cewa, “Waɗannan mutane bayin Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka ne, suna sanar da ku hanyar ceto.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:18
content: 18 Ta yi ta faɗin haka har kwanaki masu yawa. A ƙarshe Bulus ya damu ƙwarai sai ya juya ya ce wa aljanin, “A cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi na umarce ka, ka rabu da ita!” Nan take aljanin ya rabu da ita.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:19
content: 19 Da iyayengijin baranyar suka ga hanyar samun kuɗinsu ta toshe, sai suka kama Bulus da Sila suka ja su zuwa cikin kasuwa don su fuskanci hukuma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:20
content: 20 Sai suka kawo su a gaban alƙalai suka ce, “Waɗannan Yahudawa ne, suna kuma birkitar mana da gari,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:21
content: 21 ta wurin koyar da al’adun da ba daidai ba ne mu Romawa mu karɓa ko mu aikata.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:22
content: 22 Sai taron suka fāɗa wa Bulus da Sila gaba ɗaya, alƙalan kuwa suka yi umarni a tuɓe su a kuma yi musu dūka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:23
content: 23 Bayan an yi musu bulala sosai, sai aka jefa su cikin kurkuku, aka umarci mai gadin kurkukun yă tsare su da kyau.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:24
content: 24 Da karɓan irin umarnan nan, sai ya sa su can cikin ɗakin kurkuku na ciki-ciki, kuma ya ɗaura ƙafafunsu a turu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:25
content: 25 Wajen tsakar dare Bulus da Sila suna addu’a suna rera waƙoƙi ga Allah, sauran ’yan kurkuku kuwa suna sauraronsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:26
content: 26 Ba zato ba tsammani sai aka yi wata babbar girgizar ƙasa har tushen ginin kurkukun ya jijjiga. Nan da nan sai duk ƙofofin kurkukun suka bubbuɗe, sarƙoƙin kowa kuma suka ɓaɓɓalle.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:27
content: 27 Mai gadin kurkukun ya farka daga barci, sa’ad da ya ga ƙofofin kurkukun a buɗe, sai ya zāre takobinsa yana shirin kashe kansa domin ya ɗauka ’yan kurkukun sun gudu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:28
content: 28 Amma Bulus ya yi ihu ya ce, “Kada ka yi wa kanka lahani! Dukanmu muna nan!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:29
content: 29 Mai gadin kurkukun ya kira a kawo fitilu, ya ruga ciki ya fāɗi yana rawan jiki a gaban Bulus da Sila.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:30
content: 30 Sai ya fito da su waje ya kuma tambaye su ya ce, “Ranku yă daɗe, me zan yi domin in sami ceto?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:31
content: 31 Suka amsa suka ce, “Ka gaskata da Ubangiji Yesu, za ka sami ceto, kai da iyalinka.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:32
content: 32 Sa’an nan suka yi masa maganar Ubangiji shi da kuma dukan sauran da suke a gidansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:33
content: 33 A wannan sa’a na daren, mai gadin kurkukun ya ɗauke su ya wanke musu raunukansu; nan take aka yi masa baftisma da dukan iyalinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:34
content: 34 Sai mai gadin kurkukun ya kawo su cikin gidansa ya ba su abinci; ya kuwa cika da murna don yă gaskata da Allah, shi da dukan iyalinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:35
content: 35 Da gari ya waye, sai alƙalan suka aika ma’aikatansu wajen mai gadin kurkukun da umarni cewa, “Ka saki mutanen nan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:36
content: 36 Sai mai gadin kurkukun ya gaya wa Bulus cewa, “Alƙalai sun ba da umarni a sake ku kai da Sila. Yanzu sai ku tafi. Ku sauka lafiya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:37
content: 37 Amma Bulus ya ce wa ma’aikatan, “Sun yi mana dūka a fili ba tare da shari’a ba, ko da yake mu ’yan ƙasar Roma ne, suka kuma jefa mu cikin kurkuku. Yanzu suna so su fitar da mu a ɓoye? A’a! Sai dai su zo da kansu su rako mu waje.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:38
content: 38 Sai ma’aikatan suka faɗa wa alƙalan wannan, da suka ji cewa Bulus da Sila Romawa ne, sai suka ji tsoro.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:39
content: 39 Sai suka zo don su roƙe su, suka yi musu rakiya daga kurkukun, suna roƙonsu su bar birnin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 16:40
content: 40 Bayan Bulus da Sila suka fita daga kurkukun, sai suka tafi gidan Lidiya, inda suka sadu da ’yan’uwa suka kuma ƙarfafa su. Sa’an nan suka tafi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:1
content: 1 Da suka bi ta Amfifolis da Afolloniya, sai suka isa Tessalonika, inda akwai majami’ar Yahudawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:2
content: 2 Kamar yadda ya saba, Bulus ya shiga majami’ar, ranakun Asabbaci uku ya yi ta yin muhawwara da su daga cikin Nassosi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:3
content: 3 yana musu bayani da tabbatarwa cewa dole Kiristi ya sha wahala ya kuma tashi daga matattu. Ya kuma ce, “Wannan Yesu da nake sanar muku shi ne Kiristi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:4
content: 4 Waɗansu Yahudawa suka amince suka kuma bi Bulus da Sila, haka ma Hellenawa da yawa masu tsoron Allah da kuma manyan mata ba kaɗan ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:5
content: 5 Amma Yahudawa suka yi kishi; saboda haka suka tattara ’yan iska daga kasuwa, suka shirya wata ƙungiya, suka tā da tarzoma a birni. Suka ruga zuwa gidan Yason suna neman Bulus da Sila don su kawo su a gaban taron.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:6
content: 6 Amma da ba su same su ba, sai suka ja Yason da waɗansu ’yan’uwa zuwa gaban mahukuntan birnin, suna ihu suna cewa, “Waɗannan mutanen da suke tā da fitina ko’ina a duniya sun iso nan,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:7
content: 7 Yason kuwa ya karɓe su a gidansa. Dukansu suna karya dokokin Kaisar, suna cewa akwai wani sarki, wanda ake kira Yesu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:8
content: 8 Da suka ji haka, sai hankalin taron da na mahukuntan birnin ya tashi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:9
content: 9 Sai suka sa Yason da sauran su biya kuɗin saki sa’an nan suka sallame su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:10
content: 10 Da dare ya yi, sai ’yan’uwa suka sallami Bulus da Sila su tafi Bereya. Da suka isa can, sai suka shiga majami’ar Yahudawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:11
content: 11 Bereyawa kuwa sun fi Tessalonikawa hankali, gama sun karɓi saƙon da marmari ƙwarai, suka kuma yi ta yin bincike Nassosi kowace rana su ga ko abin da Bulus ya faɗa gaskiya ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:12
content: 12 Yahudawa da yawa suka gaskata, haka ma waɗansu manyan matan Hellenawa da kuma mazan Hellenawa da yawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:13
content: 13 Da Yahudawan da suke a Tessalonika suka ji cewa Bulus yana wa’azin maganar Allah a Bereya, sai suka je can ma, suna zuga taro suna kuma tā da hankalinsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:14
content: 14 Nan da nan ’yan’uwa suka sa Bulus yă tafi bakin teku, amma Sila da Timoti suka dakata a Bereya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:15
content: 15 Mutanen da suka raka Bulus kuwa suka kawo shi Atens sa’an nan suka dawo da umarnai wa Sila da Timoti cewa su zo wurinsa da gaggawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:16
content: 16 Yayinda Bulus yake jiransu a Atens, ya damu ƙwarai da ya ga birnin cike da gumaka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:17
content: 17 Saboda haka ya yi ta muhawwara a majami’a da Yahudawa da kuma Hellenawa masu tsoron Allah, haka kuma da waɗanda yake tararwa a bakin kasuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:18
content: 18 Wata ƙungiyar Afikuriya da kuma masu bin ussan ilimin Sitoyik suka fara gardama da shi. Waɗansunsu suka ce, “Mene ne mai surutun nan yake ƙoƙarin faɗi?” Waɗansu suka ce, “Kamar yana wa’azin baƙin alloli ne.” Sun faɗa haka ne domin Bulus yana wa’azin labari mai daɗi game da Yesu da kuma tashin matattu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:19
content: 19 Sai suka ɗauke shi suka kawo shi wurin taron Areyofagus, inda suka ce masa, “Ko za mu san mene ne sabon koyarwan nan ya ƙunsa da kake yi?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:20
content: 20 Kana kawo mana ra’ayoyin da suke baƙo a gare mu, kuma muna so mu san mene ne suke nufi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:21
content: 21 (Duk Atenawa da baƙin da suke zama a can suna zaman kashe wando ne kawai kuma ba abin da suke yi sai dai taɗi da kuma jin sababbin ra’ayoyi.)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:22
content: 22 Sai Bulus ya miƙe tsaye a tsakiyar taron Areyofagus ya ce, “Ya ku mutanen Atens! Na dai lura cewa ta kowace hanya ku masu addini ne ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:23
content: 23 Gama sa’ad da nake zagawa, na lura da kyau da abubuwan da kuke bauta wa, har ma na tarar da wani bagade da wannan rubutu, Ga Allahn da ba a sani ba. To, abin nan da kuke yi wa sujada a matsayin abin da ba ku sani nan ba shi ne zan sanar da ku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:24
content: 24 “Allahn da ya halicci duniya da kome da yake cikinta shi ne Ubangijin sama da ƙasa, ba ya kuma zama a haikalin da aka gina da hannuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:25
content: 25 Ba a kuma yin masa hidima da hannun mutum, sai ka ce mai bukatan wani abu, domin shi kansa ne ke ba wa dukan mutane rai da numfashi da kuma kome.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:26
content: 26 Daga mutum ɗaya, ya halicci kowace al’ummar mutane, don su zauna a duk duniya; shi ne kuma ya ƙaddara lokuta bisa ga tsarinsu da kuma inda za su kasance.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:27
content: 27 Allah ya yi wannan domin mutane su neme shi mai yiwuwa kuma su lalluba su same shi, ko da yake ba shi da nisa daga kowannenmu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:28
content: 28 ‘Gama a cikinsa ne muke rayuwa muke motsi muka kuma kasance.’ Yadda waɗansu mawaƙanku suka ce, ‘Mu zuriyarsa ce.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:29
content: 29 “Saboda haka da yake mu zuriyar Allah ce, kada mu yi tsammani cewa kamannin Allah yana kama da zinariya ko azurfa ko dutse, siffar da mutum ya ƙago ta wurin dabararsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:30
content: 30 A dā Allah ya kawar da Allah ya kawar da kai ga zamanin jahilci, amma yanzu ya umarci dukan mutane a ko’ina su tuba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:31
content: 31 Gama ya sa ranar da zai yi wa duniya shari’a da adalci ta wurin mutumin da ya naɗa. Ya riga ya ba da tabbacin wannan ga dukan mutane ta wurin tā da shi daga matattu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:32
content: 32 Sa’ad da suka ji maganar tashin matattu, waɗansunsu suka yi tsaki, amma waɗansu suka ce, “Muna so mu ƙara jin ka a kan wannan batu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:33
content: 33 Da wannan, Bulus ya bar Majalisar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 17:34
content: 34 Waɗansu mutane kima suka zama mabiyan Bulus suka kuwa gaskata. A cikinsu kuwa akwai Diyonasiyus ɗan Majalisar Areyofagus, haka kuma wata mace mai suna Damaris, da waɗansu dai haka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:1
content: 1 Bayan haka, Bulus ya bar Atens ya tafi Korint.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:2
content: 2 A can ya sadu da wani mutumin Yahuda mai suna Akwila, ɗan garin Fontus, wanda ya je can ba da daɗewa ba daga Italiya tare da matarsa Firiskila, gama Kalaudiyus ya umarci dukan Yahudawa su bar Roma. Sai Bulus ya tafi yă gan su,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:3
content: 3 da yake shi ma mai ɗinkin tenti ne kamar su, sai ya zauna ya yi aiki tare da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:4
content: 4 Kowace Asabbaci kuwa yakan yi muhawwara a majami’a, yana ƙoƙari yă rinjayi Yahudawa da Hellenawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:5
content: 5 Sa’ad da Sila da Timoti suka iso daga Makidoniya, sai Bulus ya ba da kansa ga yin wa’azi kaɗai, yana tabbatar wa Yahudawa cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:6
content: 6 Amma sa’ad da Yahudawa suka yi hamayya da Bulus suka kuma shiga zaginsa, sai ya karkaɗe tufafinsa a cikin rashin yarda, ya ce musu, “Alhakinku yana a kanku! Ba ni da wani laifi. Daga yanzu zan tafi wajen Al’ummai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:7
content: 7 Sai Bulus ya bar majami’ar ya kuma tafi ƙofar da take kusa da gidan Titus Yustus, mai yi wa Allah sujada.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:8
content: 8 Kirisbus, shugaban majami’a, da dukan iyalinsa suka gaskata Ubangiji; Korintiyawa masu yawa kuwa da suka ji shi suka gaskata, aka kuwa yi musu baftisma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:9
content: 9 Wata rana da dad dare, Ubangiji ya yi magana da Bulus a cikin wahayi ya ce, “Kada ka ji tsoro; ka ci gaba da yin magana, kada ka yi shiru.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:10
content: 10 Gama ina tare da kai, ba kuma wanda zai fāɗa maka ya cuce ka, domin ina da mutane da yawa a wannan birni.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:11
content: 11 Saboda haka Bulus ya zauna a nan har shekara ɗaya da rabi, yana koya musu maganar Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:12
content: 12 Yayinda Galliyo yake muƙaddas Akayya, Yahudawa suka haɗa kai suka tasar wa Bulus, suka kuwa kawo shi cikin kotu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:13
content: 13 Suka yi zarge cewa, “Wannan mutum yana rarrashin mutane su yi wa Allah sujada a hanyoyin da suka saɓa wa doka.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:14
content: 14 A daidai sa’ad da Bulus yana shirin yin magana, sai Galliyo ya ce wa Yahudawan, “Da a ce ku Yahudawa kuna gunaguni game da munafunci, ko kuma wani babban laifi, da sai in iya sauraronku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:15
content: 15 Amma da yake ya shafi gardama ce game da kalmomi da sunaye da kuma dokarku, sai ku ji da ita da kanku. Ni ba zan zama mai shari’a kan irin waɗannan abubuwa ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:16
content: 16 Saboda haka ya kore su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:17
content: 17 Sai duk suka juya kan Sostenes shugaban majami’a suka yi masa dūka a gaban kotun. Amma Galliyo ko yă kula.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:18
content: 18 Bulus kuwa ya ci gaba da zama a Korint na ’yan kwanaki. Sa’an nan ya bar ’yan’uwa ya shiga jirgin ruwa zuwa Suriya tare da Firiskila da Akwila. Kafin ya tashi, ya aske kansa a Kenkireya saboda alkawarin da ya yi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:19
content: 19 Suka isa Afisa, inda Bulus ya bar Firiskila da Akwila. Shi kansa ya shiga majami’a ya kuma yi muhawwara da Yahudawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:20
content: 20 Sa’ad da suka roƙe shi ya ƙara ’yan kwanaki da su, bai yarda ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:21
content: 21 Amma da yake barin wurin, ya yi alkawari cewa, “Zan dawo in Allah ya yarda.” Sa’an nan ya tashi daga Afisa a jirgin ruwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:22
content: 22 Sa’ad da ya sauka a Kaisariya, sai ya haura ya gai da ikkilisiya sa’an nan ya gangara zuwa Antiyok.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:23
content: 23 Bayan ya yi ’yan kwanaki a Antiyok, Bulus ya tashi daga can ya zaga ko’ina a yankin Galatiya da Firjiya, yana ƙarfafa dukan almajirai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:24
content: 24 Ana cikin haka sai wani mutumin Yahuda mai suna Afollos, ɗan ƙasar Alekzandariya, ya zo Afisa. Shi masani ne, yana da cikakken sani na Nassosi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:25
content: 25 An horar da shi a hanyar Ubangiji, ya kuma himma ƙwarai a magana, ya kuma yi koyarwa game da Yesu, daidai, ko da yake baftismar Yohanna ce kaɗai ya sani.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:26
content: 26 Sai ya fara magana gabagadi a majami’a. Sa’ad da Firiskila da Akwila suka ji shi, sai suka gayyace shi gidansu suka ƙara bayyana masa hanyar Allah sosai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:27
content: 27 Sa’ad da Afollos ya so ya tafi Akayya, sai ’yan’uwa suka ƙarfafa shi suka kuma rubuta wa almajiran da suke can da su marabce shi. Da isowarsa, ya zama da taimako ƙwarai ga waɗanda ta wurin alheri suka gaskata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 18:28
content: 28 Gama da ƙwazo ya ƙaryata Yahudawa a muhawwara a fili, yana tabbatar daga Nassosi cewa Yesu shi ne Kiristi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:1
content: 1 Lokacin da Afollos yake a Korint, Bulus ya bi hanyar da ta ratsa ta Asiya ya zo Afisa. A can ya sadu da waɗansu almajirai,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:2
content: 2 sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Kun karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki sa’ad da kuka gaskata?” Suka amsa suka ce, “A’a, ba mu ma san akwai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:3
content: 3 Saboda haka Bulus ya yi tambaya ya ce, “To, wace baftisma aka yi muku?” Suka ce, “Baftismar Yohanna.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:4
content: 4 Bulus ya ce, “Ai, baftismar Yohanna, baftisma ce ta tuba. Ya ce wa mutane su gaskata a wani wanda yake zuwa bayansa, wato, Yesu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:5
content: 5 Da ji wannan, sai aka yi musu baftisma a cikin sunan Ubangiji Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:6
content: 6 Da Bulus ya ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, sai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sauka musu, suka kuwa yi magana da harsuna, suka kuma yi annabci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:7
content: 7 Mutane kuwa su wajen mutum goma sha biyu ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:8
content: 8 Bulus ya shiga majami’a ya yi magana gabagadi a can na watanni uku, yana muhawwara yana kuma rinjayarsu game da mulkin Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:9
content: 9 Amma waɗansunsu suka taurara; suka ƙi su gaskata kuma a gaban jama’a suka yi baƙar magana game da Hanyar. Bulus kuwa ya bar su. Ya tafi tare da almajirai ya dinga tattaunawa da su kullum a babban ɗakin jawabi na Tirannus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:10
content: 10 Wannan ya ci gaba har shekara biyu, sai da ya sa dukan Yahudawa da Hellenawa da suke zaune a lardin Asiya suka ji maganar Ubangiji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:11
content: 11 Allah ya yi ayyukan banmamakin da suka wuce misali ta hannu Bulus,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:12
content: 12 har ma ana kai hankicif da adikan da suka taɓa jikinsa wa marasa lafiya, suka kuwa warke daga cututtukansu mugayen ruhohi kuma suka rabu da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:13
content: 13 Waɗansu Yahudawa masu yawo gari-gari suna fitar da mugayen ruhohi suka yi ƙoƙari su yi amfani da sunan Ubangiji Yesu a kan waɗanda suke da aljanu. Suna cewa, “A cikin sunan Yesu wanda Bulus yake wa’azi, na umarce ku, ku fito.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:14
content: 14 ’Ya’ya bakwai maza na Sikeba, wani babban firist na Yahudawa, suna yin haka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:15
content: 15 Wata rana mugun ruhu ya amsa musu ya ce, “Yesu kam na sani, Bulus kuma na sani, amma ku kuma su wane ne?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:16
content: 16 Sai mutumin da yake da mugun ruhun ya fāɗa musu ya sha ƙarfinsu duka. Ya yi musu dūkan tsiya har suka fita a guje daga gidan tsirara jini yana zuba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:17
content: 17 Da Yahudawa da Hellenawan da suke zama a Afisa suka ji wannan labari sai duk tsoro ya kama su, aka kuwa darjanta sunan Ubangiji Yesu ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:18
content: 18 Da yawa cikin waɗanda suka gaskata yanzu suka zo a fili suka furta mugayen ayyukansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:19
content: 19 Waɗansu masu yin sihiri suka kawo naɗaɗɗun littattafansu wuri ɗaya suka kuwa ƙone su a gaban jama’a. Sa’ad da aka lissafta yawan kuɗin naɗaɗɗun littattafan nan, sai jimillar ta kai darik dubu hamsin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:20
content: 20 Ta haka maganar Ubangiji ta bazu ko’ina ta kuma yi ƙarfi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:21
content: 21 Bayan dukan wannan ya faru, sai Bulus ya yanke shawara ya ratsa Makidoniya da Akayya in za shi Urushalima. Ya kuma ce, “Bayan na tafi can, dole in ziyarci Roma ita ma.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:22
content: 22 Sai ya aiki biyu daga cikin masu taimakonsa, Timoti da Erastus, zuwa Makidoniya, yayinda shi kuwa ya ɗan dakata a lardin Asiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:23
content: 23 Kusan wannan lokaci sai aka yi wani babban hargitsi game da wannan Hanyar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:24
content: 24 Wani maƙerin azurfa, mai suna Demetiriyus wanda yake ƙera siffar ɗakunan tsafin Artemis da azurfa, ba ƙaramin ciniki yake kawo wa mutane masu sana’an nan ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:25
content: 25 Sai ya tara su wuri ɗaya, tare da masu irin wannan sana’ar ya ce, “Ku jama’a, kun san muna samun kuɗin shiga sosai daga wannan sana’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:26
content: 26 Kuma kuna ji kuna gani yadda Bulus ɗin nan ya shawo kan mutane da yawa ya kuma sa suka bauɗe a nan a Afisa da dukan lardin Asiya. Yana cewa alloli da mutum ya ƙera ba alloli ba ne ko kaɗan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:27
content: 27 Akwai hatsari, ba kawai cewa sana’armu za tă rasa sunanta mai daraja ba, amma za a yi banza da ɗakin tsafin Artemis alliyarmu mai girma, alliyar kanta wadda ake bauta a ko’ina a yankin Asiya da kuma duniya, za a raba ta da darajarta.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:28
content: 28 Da suka ji haka, sai suka yi fushi ƙwarai suka fara ihu suna cewa, “Girma ta tabbata ga Artemis ta Afisawa!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:29
content: 29 Jim kaɗan sai hayaniya ta tashi a dukan birnin. Sai mutane suka cafke Gayus da Aristarkus, abokan tafiyar Bulus daga Makidoniya, suka ruga da zuwa fili da nufi ɗaya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:30
content: 30 Bulus ya so ya bayyana a gaban taron, amma almajirai ba su bar shi ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:31
content: 31 Har waɗansu shugabannin lardin ma, abokan Bulus, suka aika masa suna roƙonsa kada yă kuskura ya shiga filin nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:32
content: 32 Taron kuwa ya ruɗe. Waɗansu suna ihu suna ce abu kaza, waɗansu kuma wani abu dabam. Yawancin mutane kuma ba su ma san abin da ya sa suke a wurin ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:33
content: 33 Yahudawa suka tura Alekzanda gaba, sai waɗansu a taron suka riƙa yin masa ihu. Sai ya ɗaga hannu don a yi shiru don yă kāre kansa a gaban mutane.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:34
content: 34 Amma sa’ad da suka gane shi mutumin Yahuda ne, sai duk suka yi ihu gaba ɗaya na kusa sa’a biyu, suna cewa, “Girma ta tabbata ga Artemis ta Afisawa!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:35
content: 35 Sai magatakardar birnin ya sa taron su yi shiru, sa’an nan ya ce, “Mutanen Afisa, ashe duk duniya ba tă san cewa birnin Afisa ce mai lura da haikalin Artemis mai girma da kuma siffarta da ya fāɗi daga sama ba?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:36
content: 36 Saboda haka, da yake ba dama a yi mūsun wannan gaskiya, ya kamata ku natsu kada ku yi kome da garaje.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:37
content: 37 Kun kawo mutanen nan a nan, gashi kuwa ba su yi fashin haikali ba, ba su kuwa saɓa wa alliyarmu ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:38
content: 38 To, in haka ne, in Demetiriyus da abokan sana’arsa suna da wata magana game da wani ai, kotuna suna nan a buɗe, akwai kuma muƙaddasai. Suna iya kai ƙara.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:39
content: 39 In kuma akwai wani abu har yanzu da kuke so ku kawo, dole a daidaita shi a majalisa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:40
content: 40 Yadda yake a yanzu, muna a hatsarin amsa zargin ta da hargitsi saboda abin da ya faru yau. Da yake ba za mu iya ba da dalilin da ya sa aka yi wannan hargitsi ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 19:41
content: 41 Bayan da ya faɗi haka, sai ya sallami taron.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:1
content: 1 Sa’ad da hayaniyar ta kwanta, sai Bulus ya aika a kira almajiran, kuma bayan ya ƙarfafa su, sai ya yi bankwana ya tafi Makidoniya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:2
content: 2 Ya ratsa wurin yana ƙarfafa mutanen da kalmomi masu yawa, a ƙarshe kuma ya kai Giris,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:3
content: 3 inda ya zauna wata uku. Da yake Yahudawa sun ƙulla masa makirci, a lokacin da yake shirin tashi cikin jirgin ruwa zuwa Suriya, sai ya yanka shawara yă koma ta Makidoniya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:4
content: 4 Sai Sofater ɗan Fairrus daga Bereya, Aristarkus da Sekundus daga Tessalonika, Gayus daga Derbe, Timoti ma, da Tikikus da Turofimus daga lardin Asiya suka tafi tare da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:5
content: 5 Waɗannan mutane suka sha gaba suka kuma jira mu a Toruwas.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:6
content: 6 Amma muka tashi daga Filibbi a jirgin ruwa bayan Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti bayan kuma kwana biyar muka sadu da sauran a Toruwas, inda muka zauna kwana bakwai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:7
content: 7 A ranar farko ta mako muka taru wuri ɗaya don gutsuttsura burodi. Bulus ya yi wa mutane magana, don yana niyyar tashi kashegari, sai ya yi ta yin magana har tsakar dare.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:8
content: 8 Akwai fitilu da yawa a ɗakin gidan saman da muka taru.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:9
content: 9 Akwai wani saurayi zaune a taga mai suna Yitikus, wanda barci mai nauyi ya ɗauke shi yayinda Bulus yake ta tsawaita magana. Sa’ad da yake barci, sai ya fāɗi daga gidan sama a hawa ta uku aka kuma ɗauke shi matacce.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:10
content: 10 Sai Bulus ya sauka, ya miƙe a kan saurayin ya rungume shi ya ce, “Kada ku damu, yana da rai!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:11
content: 11 Sai ya koma ɗakin da yake a gidan sama, ya gutsuttsura burodi ya kuma ci. Bayan ya yi magana har gari ya waye, sai ya tafi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:12
content: 12 Mutanen suka ɗauki saurayin da rai zuwa gida suka kuma ta’azantu ƙwarai da gaske.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:13
content: 13 Mu kuwa muka ci gaba zuwa jirgin ruwan muka tashi muka nufi Assos inda za mu ɗauki Bulus. Ya yi wannan shirin don zai tafi can da ƙafa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:14
content: 14 Da ya same mu a Assos, sai muka ɗauke shi a jirgin ruwan muka zo Mitilen.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:15
content: 15 Kashegari muka tashi cikin jirgin ruwa daga can muka zo gefen Kiyos. Kwana ɗaya bayan wannan, sai muka ƙetare zuwa Samos, kashegari kuma muka iso Miletus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:16
content: 16 Bulus ya yanke shawara yă wuce Afisa a jirgin ruwa don kada yă ɓata lokaci a lardin Asiya, gama yana sauri yă kai Urushalima, in ya yiwu ma, a ranar Fentekos.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:17
content: 17 Daga Miletus, Bulus ya aika zuwa Afisa a kira dattawan ikkilisiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:18
content: 18 Da suka iso, sai ya ce musu, “Kun san irin zaman da na yi tun lokacin da na zauna da ku, daga ranar farkon da na zo cikin lardin Asiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:19
content: 19 Na bauta wa Ubangiji da matuƙar tawali’u har da hawaye, da gwagwarmaya iri-irin da na sha game da makircin Yahudawa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:20
content: 20 Kun san cewa ban yi wata-wata yin muku wa’azi game da duk abin da zai amfane ku ba amma na koyar da ku a fili da kuma gida-gida.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:21
content: 21 Na yi shela ga Yahudawa da Hellenawa cewa dole su juye ga Allah cikin tuba su kuma amince da Ubangijinmu Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:22
content: 22 “Yanzu kuma Ruhu ya tilasta ni, za ni Urushalima, ba tare da sanin abin da zai faru da ni a can ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:23
content: 23 Na dai san cewa a kowace birni Ruhu Mai Tsarki yakan gargaɗe ni cewa kurkuku da shan wuya suna jirana.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:24
content: 24 Amma ni ban ɗauki raina a bakin kome ba, in dai zan iya gama tserena in kuma kammala aikin da Ubangiji Yesu ya ba ni aikin shaida bisharar alherin Allah.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:25
content: 25 “Yanzu na san cewa ba ko ɗaya daga cikinku wanda na zazzaga ina muku wa’azin mulkin Allah da zai sāke ganina.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:26
content: 26 Saboda haka, ina muku shela a yau cewa ba ni da alhakin kowa a kaina.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:27
content: 27 Gama ban yi wata-wata a sanar muku dukan nufin Allah ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:28
content: 28 Ku lura da kanku da dukan garken da Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya sa ku ku zama masu kula da shi. Ku zama masu kiwon ikkilisiyar Allah, wadda ya saya da jininsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:29
content: 29 Na san cewa bayan na tafi, mugayen kyarketai za su shigo cikinku ba za su kuwa ƙyale garken ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:30
content: 30 Ko cikinku ma mutane za su taso su karkatar da gaskiya don su jawo wa kansu almajirai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:31
content: 31 Saboda haka ku zauna a faɗake! Ku tuna cewa shekara uku, dare da rana ban taɓa fasa yin wa kowannenku gargaɗi ba, har da hawaye.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:32
content: 32 “To, yanzu na danƙa ku ga Allah da kuma ga maganar alherinsa, wadda za tă iya gina ku ta kuma ba ku gādo a cikin dukan waɗanda aka tsarkake.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:33
content: 33 Ban yi ƙyashin azurfa ko zinariya ko tufafin kowa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:34
content: 34 Ku kanku kun san cewa hannuwan nan nawa sun biya mini bukatuna da kuma na abokan aikina.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:35
content: 35 Cikin kowane abin da na yi, na nuna muku cewa da irin wannan aiki tuƙuru don mu taimaki marasa ƙarfi, muna tunawa da kalmomin da Ubangiji Yesu kansa ya ce, ‘Bayarwa ta fi karɓa albarka.’ ”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:36
content: 36 Da ya faɗi haka, ya durƙusa tare da dukansu ya yi addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:37
content: 37 Sai dukansu suka yi kuka suka rungume shi, suka kuma yi masa sumba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 20:38
content: 38 Abin da ya fi sa su baƙin ciki shi ne maganarsa da ya ce, ba za su ƙara ganin fuskarsa ba. Sai suka raka shi zuwa wajen jirgin ruwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:1
content: 1 Bayan muka rabu da su da ƙyar, sai muka shiga jirgin ruwa, muka miƙe zuwa Kos. Kashegari muka tafi Rods daga can kuma muka je Fatara.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:2
content: 2 Sai muka sami wani jirgin ruwa da zai ƙetare zuwa Funisiya, sai muka shiga muka kama tafiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:3
content: 3 Bayan muka hangi Saifurus muka wuce shi ta kudu, sai muka ci gaba zuwa Suriya. Muka sauka a Taya, inda jirgin ruwanmu zai sauke kayansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:4
content: 4 Da muka sami almajirai a can, sai muka zauna da su kwana bakwai. Ta wurin Ruhu, suka yi ƙoƙari su hana Bulus wucewa zuwa Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:5
content: 5 Amma da lokacin tashinmu ya yi, sai muka tashi muka ci gaba da tafiyarmu. Dukan almajirai da matansu da ’ya’yansu suka raka mu har bayan birni, a can kuwa a bakin teku muka durƙusa muka yi addu’a.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:6
content: 6 Bayan mun yi bankwana da juna, sai muka shiga jirgin ruwa, su kuwa suka koma gida.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:7
content: 7 Muka ci gaba da tafiyarmu daga Taya muka sauka a Tolemayis, inda muka gai da ’yan’uwa muka yi kwana ɗaya tare da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:8
content: 8 Da muka tashi kashegari, sai muka isa Kaisariya muka kuma sauka a gidan Filibus mai bishara, ɗaya daga cikin Bakwai ɗin nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:9
content: 9 Yana da ’ya’ya huɗu ’yan mata da ba su yi aure ba, waɗanda suka yi annabci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:10
content: 10 Bayan muka yi ’yan kwanaki da dama a can, sai wani annabin da ake kira Agabus ya gangaro daga Yahudiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:11
content: 11 Da ya zo wurinmu, sai ya ɗauki ɗamarar Bulus, ya ɗaura hannuwansa da ƙafafunsa da ita sa’an nan ya ce, “Ruhu Mai Tsarki ya ce, ‘Haka Yahudawan Urushalima za su daure mai wannan ɗamara su kuma ba da shi ga Al’ummai.’ ”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da muka ji haka, sai mu da mutanen da suke can muka roƙi Bulus kada yă je Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:13
content: 13 Sai Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Don me kuke kuka kuna kuma ɓata mini zuciya? A shirye nake ba ma a daure ni kawai ba, amma har ma in mutu a Urushalima saboda sunan Ubangiji Yesu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:14
content: 14 Da dai ya ƙi rarrasuwa, muka yi shiru, muka ce, “Bari Ubangiji yă yi nufinsa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:15
content: 15 Bayan haka, sai muka shirya muka kuma haura zuwa Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:16
content: 16 Waɗansu almajirai daga Kaisariya suka raka mu suka kawo mu gidan Minason, inda za mu sauka. Shi mutumin Saifurus ne kuma ɗaya daga cikin almajirai na farko.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:17
content: 17 Sa’ad da muka zo Urushalima, ’yan’uwa suka karɓe mu da murna.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:18
content: 18 Kashegari Bulus da sauranmu muka tafi domin mu ga Yaƙub, dukan dattawan kuwa suna nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:19
content: 19 Bulus ya gaishe su ya kuma ba su rahoto dalla-dalla a kan abin da Allah ya yi a cikin Al’ummai ta wurin aikinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:20
content: 20 Da suka ji haka, sai suka yabi Allah. Sa’an nan suka ce wa Bulus, “Ka gani ɗan’uwa, yawan dubban Yahudawan da suka gaskata, kuma dukansu masu himma ne a wajen bin doka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:21
content: 21 An sanar da su cewa kana koya wa dukan Yahudawan da suke zama a cikin Al’ummai cewa su juye daga Musa, kana kuma faɗa musu kada su yi wa ’ya’yansu kaciya ko su yi rayuwa bisa ga al’adunmu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:22
content: 22 To, me za mu yi ke nan? Lalle za su ji cewa ka iso,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:23
content: 23 saboda haka, ka yi abin da muka faɗa maka. Akwai mutum huɗu tare da mu da suka yi alkawari.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:24
content: 24 Ka ɗauki waɗannan mutane, ka tafi da su ku tsarkaka gaba ɗaya, ka kuma biya musu kome don su samu su yi aski. Ta haka kowa zai sani babu gaskiya a waɗannan rahotanni game da kai, za a kuma ga cewa kai kanka kana kiyaye dokar.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:25
content: 25 Game da Al’ummai masu bi kuwa, mun yi musu wasiƙa a kan shawararmu cewa su guji abincin da aka miƙa wa gumaka, da jini, da naman dabbar da aka maƙure da kuma fasikanci.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:26
content: 26 Kashegari, sai Bulus ya ɗauki mutanen ya kuma tsarkake kansa tare da su. Sa’an nan ya tafi haikali domin yă sanar da ranar cikar tsarkakewarsu da kuma ranar da za a ba da sadaka domin kowannensu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:27
content: 27 Da kwana bakwai ɗin suka yi kusan cika, waɗansu Yahudawa daga lardin Asiya suka ga Bulus a haikali. Sai suka zuga taron duka, suka kama shi,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:28
content: 28 suna ihu suna cewa “Mutanen Isra’ila ku taimake mu! Ga mutumin da yake koya wa dukan mutane ko’ina cewa su ƙi mutanenmu da dokarmu da kuma wannan wuri. Ban da haka ma, ya kawo Hellenawa a cikin filin haikali ya ƙazantar da wurin nan mai tsarki.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:29
content: 29 (Dā ma can sun ga Turofimus mutumin Afisa a birni tare da Bulus suka yi tsammani Bulus ya kawo shi filin haikali.)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:30
content: 30 Duk birnin ya ruɗe, mutane suka zaburo da gudu daga kowane gefe. Suka kama Bulus, suka ja shi daga haikali, nan da nan aka rurrufe ƙofofi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:31
content: 31 Yayinda suke ƙoƙari su kashe shi, sai labari ya kai ga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan Roma cewa birnin Urushalima duk ta hargitse.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:32
content: 32 Nan da nan ya ɗibi waɗansu hafsoshi da sojoji suka gangara a guje wurin taron. Da masu hargitsin suka ga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan da sojojinsa, sai suka daina dūkan Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:33
content: 33 Shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya zo ya kama shi ya ba da umarni a daure shi da sarƙoƙi biyu. Sa’an nan ya yi tambaya ko shi wane ne, da kuma abin da ya yi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:34
content: 34 Waɗansu daga cikin taron suka ɗau kururuwa suna ce abu kaza, waɗansu kuma suna ce abu kaza, da yake shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya kāsa samun ainihin tushen maganar saboda yawan hayaniyar, sai ya yi umarni a kai Bulus barikin soja.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:35
content: 35 Sa’ad da Bulus ya kai bakin matakala, sai da sojoji suka ɗaga shi sama saboda tsananin haukan taron.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:36
content: 36 Taron da suka bi suka dinga kururuwa, suna cewa, “A yi da shi!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:37
content: 37 Da sojoji suka kai gab da shigar da Bulus cikin bariki, sai ya ce wa shugaban ƙungiyar sojan, “Ko ka yarda in yi magana da kai?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Ka iya Girik ne?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:38
content: 38 Ba kai ba ne mutumin Masar nan da ya haddasa tawaye har ya yi jagorar ’yan ta’ada dubu huɗu zuwa hamada a shekarun baya?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:39
content: 39 Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ni mutumin Yahuda ne, daga Tarshish a Silisiya shahararren birnin nan. In ka yarda bari in yi wa mutane magana.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 21:40
content: 40 Da ya sami izini daga shugaban ƙungiyar sojan, sai Bulus ya tsaya a matakala, ya ɗaga wa taron hannu. Da dukan suka yi shiru, sai ya ce musu da Arameyanci,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:1
content: 1 “’Yan’uwa da iyaye, ku saurari kāriyata yanzu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:2
content: 2 Da suka ji ya yi musu magana da Arameyik, sai suka yi tsit. Sai Bulus ya ce,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:3
content: 3 “Ni mutumin Yahuda ne haifaffen Tarshish na Silisiya, amma a nan birnin ne aka rene ni. Aka horar da ni sosai cikin dokokin kakanninmu a ƙarƙashin Gamaliyel ni ma dā mai himma ne cikin bauta wa Allah kamar yadda kowannenku yake a yau.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:4
content: 4 Na tsananta wa masu bin wannan Hanyar har ga mutuwarsu, ina kama maza da mata ina kuma jefa su cikin kurkuku,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:5
content: 5 kamar yadda babban firist da dukan Majalisa za su iya shaida. Na ma karɓi wasiƙu daga gare su zuwa ga ’yan’uwansu a Damaskus, na kuma tafi can don in kawo waɗannan mutane a daure zuwa Urushalima don a hukunta su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:6
content: 6 “Wajen tsakar rana da na yi kusa da Damaskus, ba zato ba tsammani sai wani babban haske daga sama ya haskaka kewaye da ni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:7
content: 7 Sai na fāɗi a ƙasa na kuma ji wata murya ta ce mini, ‘Shawulu! Shawulu! Don me kake tsananta mini?’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:8
content: 8 “Sai na yi tambaya na ce, ‘Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?’ “Ya amsa ya ce, ‘Ni ne Yesu Banazare, wanda kake tsanantawa.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:9
content: 9 Abokan tafiyata suka ga hasken, amma ba su fahimci muryar mai magana da ni ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:10
content: 10 “Sai na yi tambaya, na ce, ‘Me zan yi, ya Ubangiji?’ “Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Tashi, ka tafi cikin Damaskus. A can za a faɗa maka duk abin da aka shirya za ka yi.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:11
content: 11 Abokan tafiyata suka ja ni a hannu zuwa cikin Damaskus, saboda ƙarfin hasken ya makanta ni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:12
content: 12 “Wani mutumin da ake kira Ananiyas ya zo ya gan ni. Shi mai ibada ne wajen kiyaye dokoki wanda dukan Yahudawan da suke zama a can suna girmama shi ƙwarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:13
content: 13 Ya tsaya kusa da ni ya ce, ‘Ɗan’uwa Shawulu, ka sami ganin garinka!’ A daidai lokacin kuwa na iya ganinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:14
content: 14 “Sa’an nan ya ce, ‘Allah na kakanninmu ya zaɓe ka ka san nufinsa ka kuma ga Mai Adalcin nan ka kuma ji kalmomi daga bakinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:15
content: 15 Za ka zama mai shaidarsa ga dukan mutane game da abin da ka gani ka kuma ji.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:16
content: 16 Yanzu me kake jira? Ka tashi, a yi maka baftisma, a wanke zunubanka, ta wurin kira bisa ga sunansa.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:17
content: 17 “Sa’ad da na dawo Urushalima ina cikin addu’a a haikali, sai na ga wahayi

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:18
content: 18 na ga Ubangiji yana magana. Ya ce mini, ‘Maza! Ka bar Urushalima, gama ba za su yarda da shaidarka game da ni ba.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:19
content: 19 “Na amsa na ce, ‘Ubangiji, waɗannan mutane sun san cewa na bi majami’a-majami’a na jefa waɗanda suka gaskata da kai a cikin kurkuku, in kuma yin musu dūka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:20
content: 20 Sa’ad da kuma aka zub da jinin Istifanus mashaidinka, na tsaya can ina ba da goyon bayana ina kuma tsaron tufafin masu kisansa.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:21
content: 21 “Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce mini, ‘Je ka; zan aike ka can nesa a wurin Al’ummai.’ ”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:22
content: 22 Taron suka saurari Bulus sai da ya yi wannan magana. Sa’an nan suka ɗaga muryoyinsu suka yi ihu suka ce, “A raba duniya da wannan mutum! Bai cancanci yă rayu ba!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:23
content: 23 Da suna ihu suna kaɗa mayafansu suna da tā da ƙura sama,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:24
content: 24 sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya umarta a kai Bulus a barikin soja. Ya ba da umarni a yi masa bulala a kuma tambaye shi abin da ya sa mutane suke masa ihu haka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:25
content: 25 Suna kwantar da shi ke nan domin a yi masa bulala, sai Bulus ya ce wa jarumin da yake tsaye a nan, “Ashe, daidai ne bisa ga doka a yi wa ɗan ƙasar Roma bulala wanda ba a ma tabbatar da laifi a kansa ba?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:26
content: 26 Da jarumin ya ji haka sai ya je wurin shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ce masa, “Me kake so yi ne? Wannan mutum ɗan ƙasar Roma ne.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:27
content: 27 Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya je ya tambayi Bulus ya ce, “Faɗa mini, kai ɗan ƙasar Roma ne?” Bulus ya ce, “I.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:28
content: 28 Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ce, “Sai da na biya kuɗi mai yawa kafin in zama ɗan ƙasa.” Bulus ya ce, “Ni kuwa an haife ni ɗan ƙasa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:29
content: 29 Waɗanda dā suke shirin yin masa tambayoyi suka ja da baya nan da nan. Shugaban ƙungiyar sojan kansa ya tsorata da ya fahimci cewa ya sa wa Bulus, ɗan ƙasar Roma sarƙa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 22:30
content: 30 Kashegari da yake shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya so yă tabbatar da ainihin abin da ya sa Yahudawa suke zargin Bulus, sai ya sake shi ya kuwa umarci manyan firistoci da dukan Majalisar su taru. Sa’an nan ya kawo Bulus ya sa ya tsaya a gabansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:1
content: 1 Bulus ya zuba wa Majalisar ido ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, na cika aikina ga Allah cikin lamiri mai kyau har yă zuwa yau.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:2
content: 2 Da jin wannan Ananiyas babban firist ya umarci waɗanda suke tsaye kusa da Bulus su buge bakinsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:3
content: 3 Sai Bulus ya ce masa, “Allah zai buge ka, kai farin bango! Ka zauna a can kana hukunta ni bisa ga doka, ga shi kai kanka kana ƙetare dokar ta wurin ba da umarni a buge ni!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:4
content: 4 Waɗanda suke tsaye kusa da Bulus kuwa suka ce masa, “Babban firist na Allah za ka zaga?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:5
content: 5 Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “’Yan’uwa, ai, ban san cewa shi ne babban firist ba; gama yana a rubuce cewa, ‘Kada ka yi mugun magana game da mai mulkin mutanenka.’”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:6
content: 6 Bulus, da ya gane cewa waɗansu daga cikinsu Sadukiyawa ne sauran kuma Farisiyawa ne, sai ya ɗaga murya a Majalisar ya ce, “’Yan’uwana, ni Bafarisiye ne, ɗan Farisiyawa. Ana mini shari’a saboda begen da nake da shi a kan tashin matattu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:7
content: 7 Da ya faɗi haka, sai gardama ta tashi tsakanin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa, taron kuwa ya rabu biyu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:8
content: 8 (Sadukiyawa suna cewa babu tashin matattu, babu mala’iku ko ruhohi. Amma Farisiyawa kuwa sun tsaya a kan cewa duk akwai.)

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:9
content: 9 Aka yi babbar hayaniya. Waɗansu daga cikin malaman dokokin da suke Farisiyawa suka miƙe tsaye suka yi gardama mai ƙarfi suna cewa, “Ba mu sami wani laifi a wurin mutumin nan ba. A ce wani ruhu ko mala’ika ne ya yi masa magana fa?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:10
content: 10 Gardamar kuwa ta yi tsanani har shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya ji tsoro za su yayyage Bulus. Ya umarci sojoji su tafi su ƙwace shi ƙarfi da yaji daga wurinsu su kawo shi cikin barikin soja.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:11
content: 11 Kashegari da dare Ubangiji ya tsaya kusa da Bulus ya ce, “Ka yi ƙarfin hali! Don kamar yadda ka yi shaida game da ni a Urushalima, haka kuma lalle, za ka yi shaidata a Roma.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:12
content: 12 Kashegari, Yahudawa suka ƙulla makirci suka kuma yi rantsuwa cewa ba za su ci ko sha ba sai sun kashe Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:13
content: 13 Fiye da mutane arba’in ne suka ƙulla wannan makirci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:14
content: 14 Suka je wajen manyan firistoci da dattawa suka ce, “Mun yi babbar rantsuwa cewa ba za mu ci kome ba sai mun kashe Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:15
content: 15 Saboda haka, sai ku da Majalisa sai ku roƙi shugaban ƙungiyar sojan yă kawo shi a gabanku kamar kuna so ku ƙara samun cikakken bayani game da zancensa. Mu kuwa muna a shirye mu kashe shi kafin yă iso nan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:16
content: 16 Amma da ɗan ’yar’uwar Bulus ya ji wannan makirci, sai ya tafi cikin barikin soja ya gaya wa Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:17
content: 17 Sai Bulus ya kira ɗaya daga cikin jarumawan ya ce, “Ka kai wannan saurayi wurin shugaban ƙungiyar soja; yana da wani abin da zai faɗa masa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:18
content: 18 Saboda haka ya ɗauke shi ya kai wajen shugaban ƙungiyar sojan. Jarumin ya ce, “Bulus, ɗan kurkukun nan ya kira ni, ya roƙe ni in kawo wannan saurayi a wurinka domin yana da wani abin da zai faɗa maka.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:19
content: 19 Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya kama hannun saurayin ya ja shi gefe, ya tambaye shi cewa, “Mene ne kake so ka gaya mini?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:20
content: 20 Saurayin ya ce, “Yahudawa sun ƙulla za su roƙe ka ka kawo Bulus a gaban Majalisa gobe kamar suna neman ƙarin cikakken bayani game da Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:21
content: 21 Kada ka yarda da su, domin fiye da mutum arba’in daga cikinsu suna fakonsa. Sun yi rantsuwa ba za su ci ko sha ba sai sun kashe shi. Suna nan a shirye yanzu, suna jira ka amince da roƙonsu.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:22
content: 22 Sai shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya sallami saurayin ya kwaɓe shi ya ce, “Kada ka gaya wa kowa cewa ka faɗa mini wannan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:23
content: 23 Sai ya kira biyu daga cikin jarumawansa, ya umarce su cewa, “Ku shirya sojoji ɗari biyu, da masu hawan dawakai saba’in da kuma masu māsu ɗari biyu su tafi Kaisariya da ƙarfe tara na daren nan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:24
content: 24 Ku shirya wa Bulus dawakai da zai hau don a kai shi wurin Gwamna Felis lafiya.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:25
content: 25 Ya kuma rubuta wasiƙa kamar haka,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:26
content: 26 Kalaudiyus Lisiyas. Zuwa ga Mai Girma, Gwamna Felis. Gaisuwa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:27
content: 27 Yahudawa sun kama wannan mutum suna kuma dab da kashe shi, amma na zo da sojojina na ƙwato shi, saboda na ji shi ɗan ƙasar Roma ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:28
content: 28 Na so in san abin da ya sa suke zarginsa, saboda haka na kawo shi a gaban Majalisarsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:29
content: 29 Na tarar cewa zargin da ake masa ya shafi waɗansu abubuwan da suka shafi dokarsu ne, amma ba wani zargi a kansa da ya isa kisa ko a daure shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:30
content: 30 Sa’ad da na sami labari cewa akwai wani makircin da aka ƙulla masa, sai na aika shi wurinka nan da nan. Na kuma umarci masu zarginsa su kai ƙararsu gare ka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:31
content: 31 Saboda haka sojojin, don cika umarni, suka ɗauki Bulus da dad dare suka kawo shi har Antifatiris.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:32
content: 32 Kashegari suka bar masu hawan dawakai suka ci gaba da shi, yayinda sojojin suka koma barikin soja.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:33
content: 33 Sa’ad da masu hawan dawakai suka isa Kaisariya, sai suka ba wa gwamna wasiƙar suka kuma miƙa masa Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:34
content: 34 Gwamna ya karanta wasiƙar ya kuma tambaya ko daga wanda lardi ne ya fito. Da ya ji cewa shi daga Silisiya ne,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 23:35
content: 35 sai ya ce, “Zan ji batunka lokacin da masu zarginka suka iso.” Sa’an nan ya ba da umarni a kai Bulus a tsare shi a fadar Hiridus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:1
content: 1 Bayan kwana biyar sai Ananiyas babban firist ya tafi Kaisariya tare da waɗansu daga cikin dattawa da kuma wani lauya mai suna Tertullus, suka kawo ƙararsu game da Bulus a gaban gwamna.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da aka shigo da Bulus, sai Tertullus ya shiga kai ƙararsa a gaban Felis yana cewa, “Mun daɗe muna zaman lafiya a ƙarƙashinka, hangen nesanka kuma ya kawo gyare-gyare a wannan ƙasa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:3
content: 3 Ko’ina da kuma a kowace hanya, ya mafifici Felis, mun amince da wannan da godiya marar iyaka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:4
content: 4 Amma don kada in ƙara gajiyar da kai, ina roƙonka ka yi haƙuri ka saurari ɗan taƙaitaccen jawabinmu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:5
content: 5 “Mun tarar da wannan mutum fitinanne ne, yana tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a tsakanin Yahudawa ko’ina a duniya. Shi shugaban ɗarikar Nazarawa

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:6
content: 6 har ma ya yi ƙoƙari ya ƙazantar da haikali; shi ya sa muka kama shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:8
content: 8 Ta wurin bincika shi da kanka za ka gane gaskiyar game da dukan waɗannan zargin da muke kawo a kansa.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:9
content: 9 Yahudawa ma suka goyi bayan zargin, suna tabbatar cewa waɗannan abubuwa haka suke.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:10
content: 10 Da gwamna ya yi masa alama yă yi magana, sai Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Na san cewa ka yi shekaru da yawa kana mulki a wannan ƙasa; saboda haka ina farin ciki in kāre kaina.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:11
content: 11 Da sauƙi za ka iya tabbatar cewa, bai fi kwana goma sha biyu da suka wuce ne na tafi Urushalima, domin yin sujada ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:12
content: 12 Masu zargina ba su same ni ina gardama da kowa a haikali, ko kuma ina tā da hankalin jama’a a majami’u ko kuwa wani wuri dabam a cikin birni ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:13
content: 13 Ba kuwa za su iya tabbatar maka ƙarar da suke yi yanzu a kaina ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:14
content: 14 Amma na yarda cewa ina bauta wa Allah na kakanninmu a matsayin mai bin Hanyar da suke kira ɗarika. Na gaskata dukan abin da ya amince da Doka da yake kuma a rubuce cikin Annabawa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:15
content: 15 ina kuma da irin bege ɗaya ga Allah yadda mutanen nan suke da shi, cewa akwai tashin matattu masu adalci da masu mugunta duka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:16
content: 16 Saboda haka, ina ƙoƙari kullum in kasance da lamiri mai tsabta a gaban Allah da mutane.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:17
content: 17 “Bayan ’yan shekaru da dama da ba na nan, sai na dawo Urushalima don in kawo wa mutanena kyautai saboda matalauta in kuma yi sadaka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:18
content: 18 Ni tsarkake ne sa’ad da suka same ni cikin filin haikalin ina yin haka. Babu taro tare da ni, ba kuwa ina tā da hankali ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:19
content: 19 Amma akwai waɗansu Yahudawa daga lardin Asiya, waɗanda ya kamata suna a nan a gabanka su kawo ƙara in suna da wani a kaina.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:20
content: 20 Ko kuwa waɗannan da suke a nan su faɗi laifin da suka same ni da shi sa’ad da na tsaya a gaban Majalisa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:21
content: 21 sai ko wannan abu ɗaya kaɗai da na ɗaga murya na faɗi yayinda nake tsaye a gabansu cewa, ‘A game da tashin matattu ake mini shari’a a gabanku yau.’ ”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:22
content: 22 Sai Felis, wanda yake da cikakken sani game da Hanyar, ya ɗaga sauraron ƙarar. Ya ce, “In Lisiyas shugaban ƙungiyar soja ya iso, zan yanke muku shari’a.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:23
content: 23 Ya yi wa jarumin umarni yă tsare Bulus amma yă ba shi ’yanci yă kuma bar abokansa su lura da bukatunsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:24
content: 24 Bayan ’yan kwanaki da dama sai Felis ya zo da matarsa Durusilla, mutuniyar Yahuda. Sai ya aika a zo da Bulus ya kuma saurare shi da yake magana game da bangaskiya cikin Kiristi Yesu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:25
content: 25 Da Bulus ya ci gaba jawabi a kan adalci, kamunkai da kuma hukunci mai zuwa, sai Felis ya tsorata ya ce, “Yanzu kam, ya isa haka! Kana iya tafi. In na sami zarafi, zan kira ka.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:26
content: 26 A wani fanni yana sa rai cewa Bulus zai ba shi toshiyar baki, saboda haka ya yi ta aika a kira masa Bulus yă yi magana da shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 24:27
content: 27 Da shekaru biyu suka wuce, sai Forsiyus Festus, ya gāji Felis, amma domin Felis ya so yă biya wa Yahudawa bukata, sai ya bar Bulus a kurkuku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:1
content: 1 Kwana uku bayan isowa a lardin, sai Festus ya haura daga Kaisariya zuwa Urushalima,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:2
content: 2 inda manyan firistoci da shugabannin Yahudawa suka bayyana a gabansa suka kuma gabatar da ƙararsu a kan Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:3
content: 3 Suka roƙi Festus a gaggauce a matsayin alfarma gare su, da yă sa a mai da Bulus Urushalima, gama sun ’yan kwanto su kashe shi a hanya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:4
content: 4 Festus ya amsa ya ce, “Bulus yana tsare a Kaisariya, ni da kaina kuma zan je can ba da daɗewa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:5
content: 5 Ku sa waɗansu daga cikin shugabanninku su tafi tare da ni su kawo ƙararsu a kan mutumin a can, in ya aikata wani laifi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:6
content: 6 Bayan ya yi kwanaki takwas ko goma tare da su, sai ya gangara zuwa Kaisariya, kashegari kuma ya kira a yi zaman kotu ya kuma umarta a kawo Bulus a gabansa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:7
content: 7 Da Bulus ya bayyana, sai Yahudawan da suka gangaro daga Urushalima suka tsaya kewaye shi, suna kawo ƙarar masu tsanani da yawa a kansa, waɗanda ba su iya tabbatarwa ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:8
content: 8 Sa’an nan Bulus ya kāre kansa ya ce, “Ban aikata wani laifi game da dokokin Yahudawa ko game da haikali ko kuma game da Kaisar ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:9
content: 9 Festus, da yake yana so yă yi wa Yahudawa alfarma, sai ya ce wa Bulus, “Ka yarda ka je Urushalima a yi maka shari’a a can a gabana a kan waɗannan zarge?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:10
content: 10 Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Yanzu ina tsaye a gaban kotun Kaisar, inda ya kamata a yi mini shari’a. Ban yi wani laifi ga Yahudawa ba, kai da kanka ma ka san da haka sarai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:11
content: 11 In kuwa ina da wani laifin da ya isa kisa, ban ƙi in mutu ba. Amma in ƙarar da waɗannan Yahudawa suka kawo a kaina ba gaskiya ba ne, ba wanda yake da iko ya ba da ni a gare su. Na ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:12
content: 12 Bayan Festus ya yi shawara da majalisarsa sai ya ce, “Ka ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar. To, ga Kaisar kuwa za ka tafi!”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:13
content: 13 Bayan ’yan kwanaki sai Sarki Agiriffa da Bernis suka iso Kaisariya don su yi wa Festus gaisuwar bangirma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:14
content: 14 Da yake za su yi kwanaki da dama a can, sai Festus ya tattauna batun Bulus da sarki. Ya ce, “Akwai mutumin da Felis ya bari a daure.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:15
content: 15 Sa’ad da na je Urushalima, manyan firistoci da dattawan Yahudawa suka kawo ƙara game da shi suka kuma nema a hukunta shi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:16
content: 16 “Na gaya musu cewa ba al’adar Romawa ba ce a hukunta mutum kafin ya fuskanci masu ƙararsa ya kuma sami damar kāre kansa game da ƙararsu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:17
content: 17 Da suka zo nan tare da ni, ban yi wani jinkiri ba, na kira zaman kotu kashegari kuma na umarta a kawo mutumin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:18
content: 18 Sa’ad da masu zarginsa suka tashi tsaye don su yi magana, ba su zarge shi da wani laifin da na yi tsammani ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:19
content: 19 A maimako haka, sai suka kawo waɗansu ’yan maganganu game da addininsu da ba su yarda da shi ba da kuma game da wani Yesu da ya mutu wanda Bulus ya ce yana da rai.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:20
content: 20 Na rasa yadda zan bincike irin abubuwan nan; saboda haka na yi tambaya ko zai yarda ya tafi Urushalima a yi masa shari’a a can game da waɗannan zargi.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:21
content: 21 Da Bulus ya ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Babban Sarki sai na umarta a tsare shi har kafin in aika shi zuwa ga Kaisar.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:22
content: 22 Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Festus, “Ni ma zan so in saurari mutumin da kaina.” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Za ka kuwa ji shi gobe.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:23
content: 23 Kashegari Agiriffa da Bernis suka yi shiga irin ta sarauta suka shiga ɗakin jama’a tare da manyan sojoji da manyan mutanen birni. Da umarnin Festus, sai aka shigo da Bulus.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:24
content: 24 Sai Festus ya ce, “Sarki Agiriffa, da kuma dukan waɗanda suke tare da mu, kun ga wannan mutum! Dukan jama’ar Yahudawa sun kawo mini kararsa a Urushalima da kuma a nan Kaisariya, suna kururuwa suna cewa bai kamata a bar shi da rai ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:25
content: 25 Ban same shi da wani laifin da ya isa kisa ba, amma saboda ya ɗaukaka ƙararsa zuwa gaban Babban Sarki sai na yanke shawara in aika da shi Roma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:26
content: 26 Ba ni da wata tabbatacciyar maganar da zan rubuta wa Mai Girma game da shi. Saboda haka na kawo shi a gabanku duka, musamman a gabanka, Sarki Agiriffa, saboda a sakamakon wannan bincike zan iya samun abin da zan rubuta.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 25:27
content: 27 Don a ganina wauta ce a aika da ɗan kurkuku ba tare da an nuna zargin da ake yi a kansa ba.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:1
content: 1 Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Bulus, “An ba ka izini ka yi magana.” Saboda haka Bulus ya yi alama da hannunsa ya fara kāriyarsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:2
content: 2 Ya ce, “Sarki Agiriffa, na yi sa’a da na tsaya a gabanka yau yayinda nake kāriyata game da dukan zargin Yahudawa,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:3
content: 3 musamman ma domin ka saba sosai da dukan al’adun Yahudawa da kuma maganganunsu. Saboda haka ina roƙonka ka saurare ni da haƙuri.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:4
content: 4 “Yahudawa duk sun san yadda na yi rayuwa tun ina yaro, daga farkon rayuwata a ƙasarmu da kuma a Urushalima.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:5
content: 5 Sun san ni tun da daɗewa za su kuwa shaida, in suna so, cewa bisa ga ɗarikar addininmu mafi tsanani, na yi rayuwar Bafarisiye ne.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:6
content: 6 Yanzu kuwa saboda begena cikin abin da Allah ya yi wa kakanninmu alkawari ne, ake mini shari’a yau.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:7
content: 7 Wannan shi ne alkawarin da kabilanmu goma sha biyu suke bege su ga cikawarsa, yayinda suke bauta wa Allah da himma dare da rana. Ya Sarki, saboda wannan bege ne fa Yahudawa suke zargena.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:8
content: 8 Don me wani a cikinku zai yi shakka cewa Allah yana tā da matattu?

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:9
content: 9 “Ni ma a dā na tabbata cewa ya kamata in yi duk abin da zan iya yi domin in yi gāba da sunan Yesu Banazare.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:10
content: 10 Abin da na yi ke nan a Urushalima. Da izinin manyan firistoci na sa tsarkaka da yawa a kurkuku, sa’ad da kuma ake kashe su, nakan ka da ƙuri’ata gāba da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:11
content: 11 Sau da dama nakan bi majami’a-majami’a, in sa a yi musu hukunci. Na kuma yi ƙoƙarin tilasta su su yi saɓo. Don kuma tsananin fushi da su, sai da na fafare su har waɗansu garuruwa na ƙetaren iyaka, ina tsananta musu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:12
content: 12 “A cikin irin tafiye-tafiyen nan ne ina kan hanya zuwa Damaskus tare da izini daga manyan firistoci.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:13
content: 13 Da tsakar rana, ya sarki, sa’ad da nake kan hanya, sai na ga wani haske daga sama, fiye da hasken rana, yana haskakawa kewaye da ni da abokan tafiyata.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:14
content: 14 Dukanmu muka fāɗi ƙasa, na kuwa ji wata murya tana ce mini da harshen Arameyik, ‘Shawulu, Shawulu, don me kake tsananta mini? Yana da wuya ka shuri tsinken tsokanar dabba.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:15
content: 15 “Sai na yi tambaya na ce, ‘Wane ne kai, ya Ubangiji?’ “Ubangiji ya ce, ‘Ni ne Yesu wanda kake tsananta wa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:16
content: 16 Yanzu ka tashi, ka tsaya da ƙafafunka. Na bayyana a gare ka don in naɗa ka bawa da kuma mai shaidar abin da ka gani game da ni da kuma abin da zan nuna maka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:17
content: 17 Zan tsirar da kai daga mutanenka da kuma daga Al’ummai. Ina aikan ka zuwa gare su domin

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:18
content: 18 ka buɗe idanunsu su kuwa juyo daga duhu zuwa haske, daga mulkin Shaiɗan kuma zuwa wurin Allah, domin su sami gafarar zunubai da kuma matsayi a cikin waɗanda aka tsarkake ta wurin bangaskiya a cikina.’

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:19
content: 19 “Saboda haka fa, Sarki Agiriffa, ban yi rashin biyayya ga wahayin nan daga sama ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:20
content: 20 Da farko ga waɗanda suke a Damaskus, sa’an nan ga waɗanda suke a Urushalima da kuma cikin dukan Yahudiya, da kuma ga Al’ummai su ma, na yi wa’azi don su tuba su juyo ga Allah su kuma tabbatar da tubansu ta wurin ayyukansu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:21
content: 21 Shi ya sa Yahudawa suka kama ni a filin haikali suka kuma yi ƙoƙarin kashe ni.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:22
content: 22 Amma na sami taimakon Allah har yă zuwa yau. Yanzu ga ni a tsaye a nan, ina shaida ga babba da yaro. Ba na faɗin kome fiye da abin da annabawa da Musa suka ce zai faru,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:23
content: 23 cewa Kiristi zai sha wahala, kuma a matsayin wanda yake na fari da zai tashi daga matattu, zai yi shelar haske ga mutanensa da kuma Al’ummai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:24
content: 24 A nan ne fa Festus ya tsai da kāriyar Bulus. Ya yi ihu ya ce, “Bulus! Kai dai ruɗaɗɗe ne, yawan karatunka yana juya maka kai.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:25
content: 25 Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ba na hauka, ya mafifici Festus. Abin da nake faɗi gaskiya ne da kuma mai kyau.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:26
content: 26 Sarki ya san waɗannan abubuwa, ina kuma iya yin magana da shi a sake. Na tabbata cewa ba ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan da ya kuɓuce saninsa, domin ba a ɓoye aka yi shi ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:27
content: 27 Sarki Agiriffa ka gaskata da annabawa? Na san ka gaskata.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:28
content: 28 Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Bulus, “Kana tsammani cewa a cikin ɗan ƙanƙanin lokaci kana so ka mai da ni Kirista?”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:29
content: 29 Bulus ya amsa ya ce, “Ko a ɗan lokaci, ko a lokaci mai yawa, ina addu’a ga Allah cewa, ba kai kaɗai ba amma duk waɗanda suke saurare ni a yau su zama abin da nake, sai dai ban da sarƙoƙin nan.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:30
content: 30 Sai sarki ya tashi, haka kuma gwamna da Bernis da kuma waɗanda suke zaune tare da su.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:31
content: 31 Suka bar ɗakin, kuma yayinda suke magana da juna, sai suka ce, “Wannan mutum ba ya yin kome da ya isa kisa ko dauri.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 26:32
content: 32 Sai Agiriffa ya ce wa Festus, “Da ba don wannan mutum ya ɗaukaka ƙara zuwa gaban Kaisar ba da an sake shi.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:1
content: 1 Sa’ad da aka yanke shawara cewa za mu tashi a jirgin ruwa zuwa Italiya, sai aka danƙa Bulus da waɗansu ’yan kurkuku a hannun wani jarumin mai suna Juliyos, wanda yake na Bataliyar Babban Sarki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:2
content: 2 Muka shiga jirgin ruwa daga Andiramitiyum wanda yake shirin tashi zuwa tasoshin da suke bakin tekun lardin Asiya, sai muka kama tafiya. Aristarkus, mutumin Makidoniya daga Tessalonika, yana tare da mu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:3
content: 3 Kashegari muka sauka a Sidon; Juliyos kuwa, cikin alheri ga Bulus, ya bar shi yă je wajen abokansa domin su biya masa bukatunsa.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:4
content: 4 Daga can kuma muka sāke kama tafiya muka zaga ta bayan tsibirin Saifurus saboda iska tana gāba da mu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:5
content: 5 Sa’ad da muka ƙetare tekun da yake sassan gaɓar Silisiya da Famfiliya sai muka sauka a Mira ta Lisiya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:6
content: 6 A can jarumin ya sami wani jirgin ruwan Alekzandariyan da za shi Italiya sai ya sa mu a ciki.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:7
content: 7 Tafiyar ta ɗauki kwanaki da yawa muna yi kaɗan-kaɗan da ƙyar muka iso kusa da gaɓar Kinidus. Da iskar ta hana mu ci gaba, sai muka bi ta bayan tsibirin Kirit ɗaura da Salmone.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:8
content: 8 Muka ci gaba a gefen gaɓar da ƙyar har muka iso wani wurin da ake kira Kyakkyawan Mafaka, kusa da garin Laseya.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:9
content: 9 An riga an ɓata lokaci da yawa, tafiya kuwa ta riga ta zama da hatsari domin a lokacin Azumi ya riga ta wuce. Saboda haka Bulus ya gargaɗe su,

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:10
content: 10 ya ce, “Mutane, ina gani tafiyarmu za tă zama da masifa ta kuma kawo babbar hasara ga jirgin ruwan da kaya, da kuma ga rayukanmu ma.”

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:11
content: 11 Amma jarumin, a maimakon ya saurari abin da Bulus ya ce, sai ya bi shawarar matuƙi da kuma mai jirgin ruwan.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:12
content: 12 Da yake tashar jirgin ruwan ba tă dace a ci damina a can ba, yawanci suka ba yanke shawara cewa mu ci gaba da tafiya, da bege za mu kai Funis mu ci damina a can. Wannan tashar jirgin ruwa ne a Kirit, tana fuskantar kudu maso yamma da kuma arewa maso yamma.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:13
content: 13 Da iska ta fara busowa daga kudu a hankali, sai suka yi tsammani sun sami abin da suke nema; saboda haka suka janye ƙugiyar jirgin ruwa suka bi ta gefen tsibirin Kirit.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:14
content: 14 Ba a jima ba, sai ga wata guguwar iska mai ƙarfin da ake kira “’Yar arewa maso gabas,” ta buga daga tsibirin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:15
content: 15 Iskar ta ci ƙarfin jirgin ruwan har ya kāsa fuskantar iskar; saboda haka muka sallamar mata tă yi ta tura mu.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:16
content: 16 Da muka bi ta bayan wani ɗan tsibirin da ake kira Kauda, da ƙyar muka jawo ɗan ƙaramin jirgin kusa da jirgin.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:17
content: 17 Da mutanen suka jawo shi cikin babban jirgin ruwan, sai suka sa igiyoyi ta ƙarƙashin jirgin ruwan kanta don su ɗaɗɗaura shi. Don gudun kada a fyaɗa mu da yashin gaɓar Sirtis, sai suka saukar da ƙugiyar jirgin ruwan, suka bari aka yi ta tura jirgin haka.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:18
content: 18 Haka muka yi ta shan bugun guguwar hadarin nan kashegari suka fara jajjefar da kayan da jirgin yake ɗauke da su a cikin teku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:19
content: 19 A rana ta uku, da hannuwansu suka jefar da kayan aikin jirgin ruwan a cikin teku.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:20
content: 20 Da dai aka yi kwana da kwanaki ba a ga rana ko taurari ba guguwar iska kuma ta ci gaba da bugowa, a ƙarshe muka fid da zuciya za mu tsira.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:21
content: 21 Bayan mutanen sun daɗe ba su ci abinci ba, Bulus ya miƙe tsaye a gabansu ya ce, “Mutane, da kun ji shawarata na kada ku tashi daga Kirit, da ba ku fāɗa wannan masifa da hasara ba.

title: Ayyukan Manzanni 27:22
